tshos lde chen 4 dga' ldan gyidakar chagda༅༅/ /rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po dpal ldan bla ma dam pa 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i chos sde chen so dga' ldan gyi dkar chag bzhugs serdzo/ /oṃ bde legs su gyur cig/ltami'i rnam 'drin zla med zas gtsang sras/ /sras kyi thu bo rgyal tshab mi pham mgosnan/ /rgyal kun yab gcig rgyal sras 'jam dbyangs zhabs/ /skyabs malngasnag sangs rgyas sras bcas gtsug gis mchod/ /snyigs dus log spyodad zun gsum pun tshogs kun/ /sel byed legs smon mkhyen rab 'od zer 'bum/ /thub bstan bcu gnyis gling bdag nyi ma mchog /rgyal ba gnyis pa'i zhabs sen gtsug na mjes/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis lung bstan gangs can gyi/ /rdo rje gdam dngos gnyis pa dpa' 'o dang / /mkha' 'gro chos skyong sprin bzhin mngon rgyu ba'i/ /dga' ldan rten gsum 'ga' tsam lo rgyus bri/ /༈ de yang rten 'di dag gi lo rgyus rgyas par mi lcogs/ mtshon tsam bshad na/ mkhan chen phyag rdor pa la dpal gsang ba'i bdag phos lung bstan pa las/ blo bzang grags pa 'di nyid ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sprul pa ste/ /paṇa chen rkyang gi lus bzunganas/ /mdodang sngags kyidon bshad cing] /nges pa kho nar 'tshang rgya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sprul pa yin la/ sprul tshul yang snyigs dus kyi log sprungad mtha' dag zil gyis mnananas bstan pa'i 19
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum kabdud rtsi'i 'od snang gis sa gsum khyab pa'i ched du phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis sngon rgyal bdabang po'irtog gi dusanasade ltar 'gyur bar byin gyis brlabs shing zugs bskyed pa'i mthus 'jig rten thams cad du mdo sngags skya chos skya bdud rtsis khyab par mdzad pa yin te/ 'jam dpal ②rgyud las/ yi ge dang ṭo pa grags pa/ /sdom brtson thams cad grags pa yang] /ston pa'i bstan pa gsal byed pa/ /bstan pa de tshe sa steng pu /rnam par nyams shing snang med la//bstan pa'i gzugs brnyan yid du 'ong] /byed par 'gyur ba ze tshom med/ /ces sogs dang] ma cig lab slon gyis/ dge slong tshul 'dzin grags pa'i mtshan thogs te/ /lung rigs seng ge'ing ro rab bsgrags pas/ /khrims 'chal log sgyod slobs pa zil gyis gnon/ /khrims 'chal dpag med yang dag khrims la sbyi1ga /shub pa nyid kyi srol lugs ji bzhin mtshungs pa yi/ /'dul khrims srol gtod ston pa'i chas rtags 'dzin/ /zhes gsungs shing] gter kha gong dang / rat+na'i sbyo lung sogs las kyang de ltar bshad pa dang / ma cig lab sgon gyis/ bstan pa gsal bar byed pa'i skyes bude ni/ zhes pa nas/ res spyan ras gzigs dbang 'o la chos zhu ba/res masgasnan sa byams pa la tshos zhu ba/ res mabosnan 4 tshe dpag med la 〈snas zhu ba/ res mgosnan 4 'jam dpal dang ku ku ri ba la chos zhu nus pa/ sems can gyi don byed pa la zugs bskyed shin tu che ba/ zhes pa nas/ 'dir byon nas dge slong gi gas su zhugs nas sangs rgyas kyi bltan pa gsal bar byed pa yin no/ /de'ang thub pa nyid kyi lung bstan thob pa dang / zhes dang /'jam dbyangs kha ches kyang / ta thā ga tas lung bstan rgyal ba'i sras/ /zhes sogs ltar lung bstan tshul yang shin tu mang ste/de'inang nas/ 'jam dpal rtsargyud las/ nga ni myangan ladas pa'i tshe/ /sa yi steng 'de stongs pa na/ /khyod nyid byis pa'i gzugs can gyis/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa byed par 'gyud /de tshedagon chen rab dga' ba/ /kha ba can na yod pa yin/ /zhes sangs rgyas 20
mas sde chen 'odaga' ldan gyidakar chagmyangan las 'das rjes 'jamadabyangs byis pa ste so skye'i tshul bzung nas sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa byed pa dang/ dgon pa chen 4 dga' ldan zhes gangs can du 'byung bar lung bltan pa ltar rnam thar zur 'debs las kyang] spre'u lo'i mjug tu yab kyi mnal lam du rgya nag ri 4 rtselnga nas 'ong zer ba'i btsun pa me tog phreng ba du ma sbrel ba'i chos gos dang / sum cu rtsagasum gyi shing lo yin zer ba dar ser sa 'dra ba'i sham thabs can/ po ñtsā khyer ba zhig byung nas/ nga khyed la gnas zhig g.yor ba yin zer nas/ zhes ba nas/ 'angam dbyangs kyi rnam 'phrul yin snyam pa byung skad ces dang/ dpal gsang ba'i bdag po mi'i rnam par rol ba mkhan chen phyag rdor ba'i gsung 'bum las/ gsang ba'i bdag pos/ byams pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i gang zag 'jamadapal dbyangs dang gnyis su med pa/ lhamodabyangs can mas rig pa ster bar byed pa phun sum tshogs pa gcig dang bco lnga'i gong nas 'brel ba yod cing] zhes serdzogs dang] mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa'i rnam thar gzigs pa lnga ldan las/ sang nyin rje la mjal dus mdangs n+ma lam 'di ltabu gcig 〉sa pa ji ltar lags zhus pas/ khyed kyis bla ma dang yi dam dbyer med du mthong ba legs/ khyed sngags kyi ched du bya ba'i gdul bya rin 4 che lta bu'i gang zag gcig yin par 'dug /nga rje btsun lan+dam dbyangs su mthong ba ltar don la gnas yod/ gzhan blo dman pa'i gang zag gis tha mal bar mthong 'ong ba yin/ zhes gsungs pa ltar dmigs brtsema'i ṭīk+ka tshig don rab gsal dang/ la)gas byed chos 'byung dang] rat+na'i sgyi lung sogs du mas bshad/yang dmigs brtsema'i ṭīka chen rnam thar zur 'debs su/ de nas bya lo zla ba dang po'i tshes bcu'i nub mosna yum gyi mnal lam du dge 'dun la 〈snags pa'i pho me bsam gyis mi khyab pas rgyal mtshan dang / rnga 'o che la sogs pa rol mo'i bye brag mtha' yas pa bzung ste/ spyan ras gzigs 'phyon pa la bsu ba byed zer gyin 'dug pas/ zhes dregags ltar sprul pa'i glegs bam 21
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum kalas kyang de ltar bshad pas sbyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa dam pa dang / yang rnam thar zur 'debs las/ yab kyi mnal lam du lcang lo can nas phyag na rdo rjes 'phangs sam snyam pa'i gser gyi rdo rje 'bar ba zhig yum la rim pa rmis pas bu stobs ldan zhig skye ba yin nam/zhes gsungs pa ltar mkhan chen phyag rdor la gsang ba'i bdag pos kyang / so so skye bo'i snang ngor bh+yor lam la gnas par grags/ kho 'o lag na rdo rjes kyang 'di'i yon tan dpag par mi nus shing lhag pa'i lha pyi nang gi mang pos rjes bzung / rigs gsum mgon pos kyang rjes su bzung ste lhag pa'i lha yin/ zhes gsungs pa ltag dpal gsang bdag phyag na rdo khu dang dbyer ma mchis pa dngaka yi dam rgyud sde bzhi'i lha mtha' yas pas byin gyis brlabs pa yang rnam thar zur 'debs su/ chos rje don grub rin chen la rmi lam du dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gzigs pas yang yang zhal gzigs par gsol ba btab pas/ sang 'od da tsam na lung pa 'di'i mda' ru yong / de bar du bde bar gyis gsungs pas/ de gang yin dpyad pa'i phyir ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par gzhag pas khyed kyi bur 'dug pa thigs pa yin/ zhes dang/ gangs can gyi rgyal ba nyi ma bdun gyi gnyis pa rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtshos gsungs pa las kyang / rgyal ba kun gyi yab gcig 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /ma rung bdud dpung langoms mdzad gshin rje gshed/ /mi yi gzugs kyis rnam rol tsong kha pa/ /zhes gsungs pa dang/ rgyal ba dge 'dun grub kyi gsung las kyang / rje rin po che la gshegs pa mi mnga' snyam zhes sogs gsungs pa ltag lan+dam dbyangs khros pa dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed mi'i zlos gar mdzad pa dang / yang ma cig lab sgron gyis lung bstan pa las sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gsal bar byed pa'i dge slong gcig 'byung byas pa de/ da ltar bshad pa'i dge slong grags pa'i mtshan 'ogs pa 'di yin/dge slong des bstan pa 'tshol ba mang du 'byung ba rnams tshar gcod cing / yang dag pa'i don 22
chos sde chen podaga' ldan gyidakar chagdang bstan pa rnam dag gi khrims srol btod pa ni ladzam bu gling du thub pas chos dngor bskor ba dang snyigs dus 'od du dge slong grags pa'i mtshan can byung nas chos srol btod ba ni mtshungs te/ zhes dngan 'jam dpal rtsargyud las/ khyod nyid byis pa'i gzugs kyis ni/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa byed par 'gyug /zhes gsungs pa dang / lha mo dri ma med pas zhus pa las kyang]byang phyogs gangs ri'i rgyud kyi char/ /dge ba ldan pa'i sa phyogs su/ /dam pa'i chos ni rgyas par 'gyud /zhes dang / mkhan chen phyag rdor ba'i lung bltan las kyang / 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa dpag med 'ong / chos sde chen 4 khyed kyi ring la 'debs/ ngage 'dun tshan che ba 'du/ 'phags pa'i slob ma lnga drug 'gra bstan pa dang sems can la phan che bar 'byung / mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs kyang ches cher gsal bar byed cing / sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon pa 'dra ba'i ring lugs 'ong] 'gro ba mang 4 zhig thar pa'i lam la nyakhrid par 'dug pas shin tu ngo mtshar zhes pa ltar mo la'i la rtsar bzhugs dus rgyal ba byams pas/ rigs kyi bu phyod kyis ni sangs rgyas lajig rten du byon pa 'dra ba zhig 'ong bar shes par byos shag ces seng ge'i sgras dbugasadabyung /gnyal smad seng ge rdzong du bcom ldan 'das dus kyi lha'or los/ khyod kyis dus kyi gshor lo 'di la rgyal 4 zla ba bzang po byon pa 'dra ba gcig 'ong ba yod do/ /zhes sngags kyi dngor los bsgyur bar byin gyis brlabs pa dang] rje btsun 'angam dbyangs la grub chen brgyad cu rgyan drug gis bskor ba yang yang gzigs nas/ mdo sngags kyi bdud tsithob pa tsam gyis grol bar byin gyis brlabs kyi bka' babs kyi bdud rtsis gdul bya mtha' yas mu med pas rgyal ba sras bcas kyi bkod pas nam mkha'i khyon ma lus gang ba ji ltar dpal gsang ba 'dus pa gsungs pa'i tshe rgyal ba sras bcas til gyi gang bu ltar gang bar mdzad pa la/ mchod pa dang smon lam rlabs chen mdzad pas skye rgu mthong thos dran reg 'dren pa'i mtho ris dang / thar pa 23
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum kadang/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam srol rgya che zhing] bstan pa dag zhing chen pos 'jig rten khyab dī spyasna /min/ )pa ༷dzo spra /sbra r+ṇi dzo/ gā da snapa sh+lau kha]༵ (shā ñtsha dh+ri m+p+raṃ zlo n+d+ra spra'i ba 〉(pa thams cadadabyar dus kyi sprin bzhin 'du zhing lusadang grib ma bzhin 'bral ba med par bla mdang rdo rje la)gas mdzad kyi bka' bzhin du rang gi rjes 'jug gdul bya bstan pa bedzin skyong spel ba la g.yel ba med par bzhugs pa kun gyis mngon sum lta bur grub cing] shes byed kyang mdo rgyud lung bstan ches mang ba lags/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i rje rgyal ba gnyis pa de nyid kyis bdud btul ba dang / chos gshor bskor ba'i gnas ni/ 'jam dpal rtsargyud las/ dus kyi tha mde la ni/ /sems can kun la mchog sbyin byed/ /'jig rten pa ni myangan 'das/ /sa yi steng ni stongs gyur na/ /khyod nyid byis pa'i gzugs kyis ni/ /sangs rgyas mdzad ba byed par 'gyug /de tshe dgon chen rab dga' ba/ /kha ba can na yod pasan/ /chu 4 gser dang ldan 'gram pu /nga ni myangan 'da' bar 'gyud /zhes kha ba can du dga' ldan zhes pa'idagon gnas sogs lung bstan pa 'di yin la/ delang gzhan gyi lung bstan la ham tshod ltabu yang min ba ni dgon pa'i ming dang gang du 'debs pa'i lung lag tshun chad gsal bar bshad pani sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'da' khas 'od srungs dang kun dga' 'o la mdo sde gdams ngag 'bogs pa bka' stsal pa'i mdo 'di'i le'u bzhi bcu pa bstan pa dwangs snyigs 'byed pa'i le'u nas du ma lung bstan pa de zur du phyung ba las/ kun dga' bos zhus pa las/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ kun dga' 'o bstan pa gso ba'i gang zag 'di ltar ro/ /da ltar nga la shel dkar gyi/ /phreng ba phul nas sems bskyed pa/ /nga yi bstan pa gso byed la/ /mtha' 'khob kha ba can ldongs su/ /'bridang ldan sgya sa mtshams su/ /dga' zhes bya ba'idagon pa 'debs/ /blo bzang zhes bya'i 24

kun mkhyen gsung 'bum karir dpyid zla 'bring po'i yar ngo'i tshes brgyad la phebs te ra mo che'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i dus thon mi saṃ k+to ṭas 'od du yi ge byas/ rgyal po 'dos rgyal srid lo drug cur bskyangs te dam pa'i chos kyi srol bzang 4 btod nas dgung lo gya gnyis pa sa pho khyi la btsun mo gnyis dang lhan cig tu shugs rje chen po rang byung gi thugs lngar rim/ rgya bza'/ bal bza'/ zhang zhung bza'/ ru yong bza'/ mi nyag bza' dang lnga bzhes kyang sras ma byung bar stod lung nas mong gza' khri lcam bzhes pa'i sras gnyis las/ gcung mang srong mang btsan gyis rgyal srid bzung]srong btsan zhakhrungs pa'i me glang nas khri rin po che 'od zer gyis brtsis pas rab byung dgu pa'i me byi yan chad la lo dgu brgya dang gcig song] de nas rab smyung bcu gnyis pa'i me sprel bar du lo nyis brgya tham pa song ba dang bsres pas lo stong dang chig brgya dang gcig song / lha sa'i rmangs gting nas me byi yan la lo brgyad brgya dang don dgu song / me sbrel 'di yan la lo stong dang don dgu/ srong btsan gshegs pa'i sa khyi yan chad la bstan pa lo stong dang lnga brgya so gsum songad sa khyi de nas brgyad cu song ba'i sa rta la r+ṇi srong lde btsan zhakhrungs/ dgung lo bcu gsum pa la rgyal pos sbra ye shes dbang 4 pho nyar mngags te/ mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho spyan drangs/ de'i lung bstan ltar slob dasan pad+ma 'byung gnas spyan drangs/ bod kyi lha srin dam la btags shing has po rir phebs/ rgyal 4 dgung lo nyir gcig pa sa stag la bsam yas gnag lag khang bzhengs/ 'tsha bzhi la grub/ kha cig nyer gnyis pa lcags 〈snas la btab zer/ de nas gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba'idage slong bcu gnyis spyan drangs/ sad mi mi bdun rab tu byung]paṇ+ḍi ta n+da ma la mi tra/ sangs rgyas gsang ba sogs dang] lo tsā ba sad mi mi bdun dang] brje dpal brtsegs sogs kyis chos mang du bsgyur/ mthar dgung lo re dgu pa me stag la 'das/kha cig lo bcu la gsang/ de'i sngon la gshegs skad/ de nas me khyi yan chad la lo bdun brgya 50
lo tshigs nyi ma'i 'od zegdang so gcig 'das/ de nas me sbrel 'di'i bar la lo dgu brgya dang sum cu so gcig 'das/bsam yas btab nas me khyi'i bar lo bdun brgya dang don dgu song / me sbrel 'di'i bar la lo dgu brgya dang don dgu song / bu'i chos 'byung du me yos la btab par bkod pas cung 'di legs pa 'dra/ 'di'i rjes su sras mu ne+e btsan pos rgyal srid mdzad/ mi rnams stogs phyug lan gsum bsnyam/ nyer dgu la 'das/ de'i rjes gcung khri srong lde btsan sad na legs kyis rgyal srid bzung / bstan pa'i zhabs tog cher mdzad nas nga bzhi pa sa mo bya la grags kyi phur 'das/ de'i sras bar pa mnga' bdag r+ṇi ral can ni sham+bha lar rigs ldan rgyal dkas byed rtsis mgo brtsams pa'i me khyi la 'khungs/ dgung 'ordzo bcu gnyis pa me bya la rgyal srid bzung] 'di ni phyag rdor sprul par grags/ 'di'i ring la ka cog zhang gsum serdzogs kyis sde sdod gsum gyi chos mang du bsgyug pho brang 'o shing rdo rgya phibs dgu zog can bzhengs/ 'di yan chad du 'od chos rgyal rnams kyis gtsug lag khang stong rtsabargyad bzhengs par grags/ rab byung mi re la mi khyim bdun bdun phul nas zhabs spyi 'or blangs/ chos 'gyur ro cog gi gzhung tshad bam grangs 'argyur byang dang bcas dkar chag tu bkod/ rgya 'od 'dum byas pa'i rdo ring gis ge bris pa sogs mdzad/ dgung lo so drug par 'das/ srong btsan sgam sa rgyal sar byon pa'i sa mo glang nas ral ba can 'das pa'i lcags bya yan chad la lo nyis brgya dang bcu gcig song 'dug pa'i ring la 'od du bstan pa snga dar gyi tha snyad byas/ lcags bya de nas me khyi yan chad la lo drug brgya dang don drug song] me sbrel 'di yan chad la lo brgyad brgya dang don drug song / glang dar gyis bstan pa bsnubs pa ma bzod nas/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo jis bsad/ de nas lo lnga bcu 'das pa chu byi la bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal 'khrangs/ de nas lo drug 'das pa sa rta la lo chen rin chen bzang po 'khrangs/ de nas lo bco lnga 'das pa chu ñtsha la pyi dar gyi mgo btsugs 51
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum kapar bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa bzhed/ de nas lo gsum 'das pa'i me byi la zhing sna nam rdo rje dbang rgyug 'khrungs/ de nas lo gnyis 'das pa'i sa ltag la pyi dar mgo tshugs par 'brom ston pa bzhed/ de nas jo 'o 'od du phebs pa'i chu ṇ+ḍa bar lo drug cu rtsabazhi'i khongs su dbus kyi lnga/ gtsang gi gsum/ mnga' ris 'od brgyad pa spun gnyis dang mkhas pa mi bcus bstan pa mdo smad nas dar bar phebs nas dbus gtsang du bstan pa srel/ sa stag nas lo bzhi 'das pa'i chu rta la jo 'o a ti sha gabrungs/ de nas lo bcu gcig 'das pa'i chu sprul la 'brog mi lo ts+tsha ba 'khrungs/ de nas lo bcu gcig 'das pa'i shing 'brug la 'gyom ston pa gasgye mor gabrungs/de nas lo bdun 'das pa'i lcags phag la nag tsho dang khu ston gnyis 'khrungs/ de nas gcig 'das ba'i chu ñtsha la dge bshes grwa ba mngon shes can dang lo chen lho phrag mar pa gnyis zhakhrungs/ snanam pas rgyal ltakhang btab/ denas gnyis 'das pa'i shing stag la zur chung gabrungs/denas gcig 'das pa'i shing yos la bka' gdams rnal 'byor pa a mes chen po zhakhrungs/ de nas gcig 'das pa'i me 'brug la 'dzeng dgon pa ba dbang phyug zhabrungs/ de nas gcig 'das pa'i me sbrul la chag khri mchogadang rgya gar phyag na gnyis zhakhrungs/ gru mer gyis thang po che btab/denas gsum 'das pa lcags sbrel la 'brom rin 4 che khams su phebs/ bla ma se btsun bsten/de nas lo bdun 'das pa na me mkha' rgya mtsho'i lo 'das te rab byung dang po mesku'os kyi re mig lon shar bdang/sham+bhalar rigs ldan nyi ma khrir phebs pa dus mnyam/'onadeng sang rigs ldan gangagi dus snyaman rigs ldan bco brgyad pa seng ge sham+bhala'i seng ge'i khrir phebasanas lodagu bcu bzhes pa rab byung bcu gnyis pa me sbrel 'de'o/ /'di nas lo bcu song ba dang] rigs ldan bcu dgu pa rnam gnon gyis khri mdzad nas lo brgyar chos ston par 'gyur ro/ /52

kun mkhyen gsung 'bum kasmras pa/phan bde 'byung gnas rgyal ba'i bstan pa mchog /sa gsum rin chen gcig pu 'di yin cing / /de 'dzin chos rgyal rnams dang mkhas rnams kyi/ /byung tshul re mig me long 'de na gsal/ /dam pa'i bstan rtsis legs bshad ches mang yang / /dang 4 bcud kyi 'gro ba'i byung tshul dang / /dam pa'i lo tshigs nyung ngu rab gsal 'di/ /rkang 'thung khod kyi yongs 'du ji bzhin du/ /lung rigs rin chen 'phreng bas rab tu mdzes/ /legs bshad tshig gi sgra don me tog bkra/ /sngon byung gtam gyi tshon ris bye bas smras/ /bltas pas kun gsal me long 'phrul 'di mtshad /'dir 'bad dge bas thub bstan dar zhing rgyas/ /ma lus 'gro rnams mngon mtho nges legs rnyed/ /skyes bu dam pa rnams skya sku tshe brtan/ /skyed pa'i nyi ma dgung nas gsal bar zugag /ces ba 'dikhang rdzogs ba'i sangs rgyas bltamasanas lo nyis stong drug brgyadang sum rgartso gcigadang] sangs rgyas nas lo nyis stong lnga brgya go drugadang] rtsargyud gsungasanas lo nyis stong lnga brgya go lnga dngad mya ngan las 'das nas lo nyis stong lnga brgyadang sum cu rtsagacigadang] grags bas bsdus rgyud mdzadanas ma stongadang dgu brgyadangadagu cu rtsadagu dang kra klo zhugasanas stongadang go gsumadang] rgyaladakas byed jis brtsamasanasadagu brgya dang ga ma bcu song ba dngaka rab byung rtsogs kyi lo drug brgyadang gyadagudangadabastan ba lnga brgya pa zag bcu'i tshul khrims le'u'i stenganasang gcig tshodas pa rab byung bcuganyis ba'i me sbrel gyi cho las zla ba'i tshes bcabazhi la mang du cas ba'idage slong lalangamadabyangs bzhad ba'i rdo rjes bris bdage legs 'pheg/ //maṅga laṃ/100

kun mkhyen gsung 'bum kaldan sangs rgyam zhabs/ /rim gnyis 'pho bar mnga' brnyes dkon rgyam pa/ /rdo rje 'dzin mchog gsum la5/ /gsang sngags mthar serdzon khyab bdag rat+na'i mtshan/ /mdo sngags dbang phyug ku shrī chen po'i zhabs/ /bstan pa'i bdag chen gnyis latshi/ /yang na/ rgyal ba'i dbang po re btsun tsong kha pa/ /mkhas grub rjedang tshos kyi rgyal mtshan dang] /chos kyi rdo rje rgyal ba dben sa pa/ /grub mtshog dam pa lnga laphyu/ /sangs rgyasawe shes paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen/ /nag phyogs kun 'groms grub dbang bsod nams grags/ /sangs rgyas bkra shis bsam grub sgang ba dang] /'angam mgon yab sras smin grol chos rgyal gnyis/ /thub bstan rgyas mdzad rnams lazlo/ /rgyal kun yab gcig rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /ma rungs gdul dka' mtha' dag 'dul ba'i phyir/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed kho dbang skur ston par/ /rtsegacig gsol 'debs dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /de ltar bstod pas byang chub snying po'i bag /'gal rkyen bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rnam rgyal te/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag grub chen brgyad la sogs/ /dngos grub kun gyis rtag tu 'byor gyur cig /ces pa ṇ+ḍa yang mang 4sa rab bskul nas/ /rang gidabang gi bla brgyud phyogs gcig yin/ /lta rigs dang dkyil lubor bdag po rdo rje 'chang / /mkhyen pa'i phung 4 rgyal ba kun gyi yab/ /dkyil gshor spro mdzad rdo rje 'jigs mdzad che/ /zla med skyabs mchog gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /'jam dbyangs dngos gyur rgyal ba gnyis pa'i zhabs/ /'dzam gling mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan mkhas grub rje/ /mdo rgyud smra(ga 'dzin mkhas grub shes rab seng] /thub bstan bdag 4 gsum la5/ /'jigs mdzad grub brjes dpal ldan bzang 4 dang / /dam can bran byas 'jam dbyangs dge 'dun 'phel/ /snyan brgyud rgyud sde'i bang mdzod bkra shis 'phags/ /mkhas dang grub brnyes gsum lazlo/ /grub dbang sprul sku paṇa chen bsam 'grub zhabs/ /mdo rgyud las bzhi'i bang mdzod brtson 'grus 'phags/ /lha dang srung mar mnga' brnyes rdo rje bzang / /grub pa'i dbang 102

kun mkhyen gsung 'bum kartag 'char thugs/ /mkha' khyab mi zad rgyan 'khor rgyud mar 'khor ba rgyal ba'i dbang por 'dud/ /gzugs brnyan tsam la dge ba'i bshes gnyen du/ /zhen pas 'bod min mdo rgyud dgongs 'grel gnad/ /ma lus legs bkrol skal ldan mkhas mang la/ /'doms mdzad bdag gi mgon rnams kun mkhyenadangos/ /mkhas rlom zhakhrul ba byis pa'i kun rgyud bzhin/ /rtog dpyod yul min blo gsal mgul ba'i rgyan/ /nyung ngu rnam gsal dpyad gsum dag pa'i ngag /dbyangs can ljags las 'ongs bzhin smra la spro/ /de yang skyes rabs las/ ya rabs rnams dang 'phrad na skyes kyi mchog /tshogs kyi nang na mkhas pa mgu bar byed/ /ces gsungs pa'i skyes kyi mchog mkhas pa dga' byed dang / /mdo sde rgyan las/ gser las brdung byas 'dra zhing pad+ma rgyas pa bzhin/ /bkres bas nyen pa g.yos legs kha zas za ba 'dra/ /'phrin yig legs pa thos 'dra rin chen snyom phye lta'i/ tshos ni 'der bshad pa las dga' ba'i mchog bskyed do/ /zhes dam chos kyi dpe 'phrin yig legs pa thos 'dra zhes bshad pa'i 'phrin yig gi rnam bzhag la/ 'phrin yig gi byung tshul dang / bye brag deng dus phyag len la 'debs tshul bshad pa dang gnyis/ dang 4 la byung tshul dngos dang / de'i brna chad ji ltar yod bshad pa gnyis/dang 4 ni/ dpag bsam 'khri shing las/ nam zhig gzugs can snying po la/ /mchog gi go cha gser 'od 'bar/ /lha yi rin chen gyis mtshan pa/ mi bdag u tra ya nas springs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltag zong khyer sgra slog gi rgyal ṭo khu tra ya nas/ rgyal 4 gzugs can snying po la 'phrin yig dang skyes la rin thang med pa'i nor bu'i khrab/ lus la reg na bde ba/ bcad par dka' ba/ 'big par dka' ba/ dug 'jil ba/ snang ba'i bdag nyid de/ yan lag lnga ldan zhig skyes su bskur bas/ de'i lan gzhan gyis glan par ma nus nas rgyal pos bskur rgyu ma rnyed pa'i tshe/ bram ze dbyar byed kyi sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs bris la bskur zhig /ces gsol 254
'phrin yig gi rnam bzhag blo gsal 'phreng mdzes/bas/ rgyal pos ston pa la zhus pas gnang lte/ dpag bsam 'khri shing las/ 'gro ba'i mig gi bsesnad nams rnams/ /gzugs can yang dag bsags pa bzhin/ /sangs rgyas sku gzugs thang ka de/ /de nas sa gzhi skyong bar springs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ de bzhin bshegs pa'i sku brnyan ris byed pa rnams kyis ci tsam brtags kyang bri bar ma nus pa'i tshe/ ston pas sku ji lta bu'i 'od kyi snang brnyan ras kyi ngos la btang bar tshon gyis mnan te bris pa'i sku brnyan dang /skyabs 'gro dang bslab pa'i gnas lnga rten 'brel lugs 'byung ldog rnams 'og tu bris/ steng du/ brtsams par bya zhing dbyung bar bya/ /sogs tshigs bcad gnyis 4 rnams skyes su stsal te/ shed mthun khyod la 'jig rten gsum na ches khyad par du 'phags pa'i skyes bskur yod na/ dpag tshad phyed dang gsum lam mtshes par byed pa dang bdag nyid dpung dang bcas pas bsus te/ sa phyogs yangs par bkur sti chen 4 dang bcas te kha phye bar mdzod cig /ces 'phrin yig bskur ba dang / rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis sangs rgyas la dad pa rnyed nas gsal rgyal gyis yab rgyal po zas gtsang la lha'i sras kyis bdud ni brnyes nas 'gro ba tshem par mdzad do/ /zhes 'phrin yig phul bas/ yab rgyal 4sa kyang pho nya lan 'ga'i rjes mar 'char ka 'o nyar mngags te yab sras mjal ba'i ched de bzhin gshegs pa spyan 'drin pa'i zhu yig rgyal po nyid kyis bris shing kha 'phrin yang bskur tshul/ dpag bsang nyakhri shing las/ gang yang mdza' las bdag mtshungs 'char ka ni/ /de dgug slad du bdag gis yang dag btang / /spring yig lag de lha rnams mngon dga' ba/ /de nyid du ni lha nyid bzhin du gyur/ /de yi kha la bdag gi 'tshen gyi tshig /springs pa gang de brjed pa ma yin nam/ /gang phyir thams cad nges par rang phan 'dod/ /gzhan gyi don la bsil ba nyid 'dzin lo/ /chags med 'di ni yud tsam ngal gso mdzod/ /rtag tu bdud rtsis khengs pa'i rnam gzigs kyis/ /myur du bdag gi lus la chags 255
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum kagyur pa/ /brtseba'i dbang gis gnyen gyi don mdzod cig /ces pa 'di thos bdag dang 'phrad pa la/ /skad cig kyang de sgyi bshol ji ltar mdzad/ /de yi zugs ni yal 'dab mnyen pa la/ /rang bzhin mdza' bcug rna rgyan med dam ci/ /zhes pa'i don can phul ba'i 'phrin yig sangs rgyas kyi phyag gis bzhes nas bklag par mdzad pa dang / yab sras mjal nas rgyal bas 'khor rnam bzhi dang / shākya rnams la chos ston pa'i tshe/ shākya ming chen gyi chung ma zla 'od kyis chos nyan pa'i tshe gzhan zil gyis gnon 'dod kyis 'bangs mo ro hi ti rang gi do shal len du btang ba'i lam du ba lang gis brdungs te bsad pa sangs rgyas la dad pa dang chos thos kyi dad dbang gis sing ga la'i rgyal po'i bu mo pu tig 'khri shing zhes par skyes/ mnyan 〈snad kyi tshong pa sing ga lar song ba rnams kyis sangs rgyas kyis gsung tshigs su bcad pa'idabyangs kyis brjod pa bu mos thos te klu de ci yin zhes dris pa na/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung ngo / /zhes brjod pas/ sangs rgyas de yang ci 'dra zhig yin dris pas der de rnams kyis de'i lan rgyas par bshad pas/ bu mo bag chags sad nas/ rang gis lag bdar te ston tha/ la zhu yig /dpag bsam 'khri shing las/ kye ma bsod nams tshong zong dag gi rnyed par gyur pa khyod ni dran pa nyid/ /rgud dang gdung ba dang ni sred pa 'joms pa'i srid pa'i sman bzang ci yang yin/ /bcom ldan las byung gtam gyi rim pa/sa nyer bskrun yang dag rig pa myong ba'i sa/ /bcom ldan 'di de bdag gi bdud miyang dag bgo skal chen por gyur pa yin/ /zhes pa'i don can bskur ba/ de'i rtogs brjod las/lha dang lha min mi yi phyag bgyis pa/ /skya dang snyun dang bsnyengs las nges 'byung zhing / /gtso 'o grags pa rgya cher rab grags pa/ /drang srong bdud rtsi'i chu las thugs rje nongs/ /zhes pu tig n+d+ra sa bdun gyi skyes dang bcas te phul ba/ dpag bsam 'khri shing las/ mu tig 'khri shing la brtsebs/ /rang nyid kyis ni spring yig bklag /ces gsungs pa ltag zugs brtsebs rgyal 256
'phrin yig gi rnam bzhag blo gsal 'tsheng mjes/ba rang nyid kyis bklag par mdzad de/ tshigs su bcad pa dang / ras kyi ngos la sku las 'od zer bkye ba ri mos mnan te bris pa'i thub pa'i sku brnyan thub pa 'od zer mar grags pa springs pa sogs kyi tshul dang / mchod sgyin ma 'phrin tshog gis bsnyen par rdzogs pa ni kha 'phrin yin gyi/ 'phrin yig bskur ba min pas/ kha 'phrin dang 'phrin yig gi khyad par ma bshig cig /de'i /rdzu ༵ zlo sduX k+ham̐ sna me zlo snapaza spri rnyi spra rnying n+dha hūm̐ ba shā ༵ spri/ par+sha dzinade dwo shā dwo sbyo snrolcu 'phrin yig rin chen 'phreng ba/ tsan+ta gau mis rang gi slob ma la springs pa'i slob springs/ slob dpon ma ti ② dras rgyal po ka ni ka la gnang ba'i ka ni lnga'i spring yig /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis/ dge slong rab gsal gzhon nu la springs pa'i spring yig /bla ma la springs pa dge slong dgon pa bas mdzad pa/ bram ze sad dza nas bu la springs pa'i spring yig /shrī dza ga ta mi tra a nan tas rgyal po zla ba la springs pa/ chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gshor bcas la/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas springs pa'i spring yig dngaka zhal gdams bslab bya'i yi ge sbrags ma'i skor dang] rgyal 4 snyan ngag mkhan la slob dpon don yod 'char gyis gdams pa dri ma med pa'i dris lan rin chen 'phreng ba/ jo ṭo chen po lha gcig nāṃ paṃ kā ra shrī dz+nyā nas bal po'i rgyal 4 ni r+ya pha la bskur ba dri ma med pa'i dris lan rin 4 che'i 'phrin yig serdzogs// dris lan 'phrin yig zung 'brel gyi skor dang / gangs can gyi ldongs 'di nyid du yang chos rgyal srong btsan sgam sos bal bza' r+ṇi btsun dang / rgya bza' gong jo gnyis spyan 'drin pa'i ched du bal 4 dang / rgya nag gi rgyal 4 gnyis la 'phrin yig slom bu gsum gsum bskur bar lo rgyus su grags pa dang / mang yul nas bka' gdams kyi mes 4 'brom chos kyi rgyal pos 'od kyi che btsun dam pa rnams la jo 4 spyan 'dren par bskul ba'i zhu yig tshigs bcad ma dang /257
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum kakhams gsum chos kyi rgyal po rje bdag nyid chen pos/ chos rje de bzhin gshegs pa dang /shar phyogs rgya nag gi rgyal po la gnang ba'i chab shog sogs dang / 'jam dbyangs mi'i gar mkhan 'dzam gling mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pas mnga' ris chos rgyal dang sde srid rgyang 6ba dang / rin spungs pa la gnang ba'i chab 〈snag dang / rgyal ba thams cad kyi bdag 4 phyag na pad+ma rgyal dbang dbyangs can bzhad pa'i rdo rjes/ 'od kyi bla chen dang sde ba so sor bka' stsal ba'i chab lhasnag skor dang] paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis mtho dman mang zhig la gnang ba'i chab tshe ga skor dang] gzhan yang gangs can gyi skyes chen khro lo byams pa'i dpal gyis kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī 'od du spyan 'dren pa'i zhu yigadangan sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa dang 7snang dbang shu sogs mkhas grub kyi skyes chen rnams skya chab shog dngaka de dag thams cad las kyang khyad par du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang gsum ma lus pa nges par gsum ldan mchog gi sprul pa'i sku'i zlos gar 'dzin pa rgyal ba thams cad kyi bdag po mkhan rin po che 'di nyid kyis paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa sa skya gdan sa gong 'og sogs bla chen gyi rigs la bka' phyosnag gnang ba dang / rgya gar nag gi rgyal 4 la gnang ba sogs stobs kyi gshor los bsgyur ba dag la gnang ba dang / mdor na chos srid kyi ched du bka' sdod chen po rnams tshun chad kyi lha dang mi'i rigs mtho dman ji snyed la gnang ba'i chab 77gdag ni/ mdo sngags rigs gnas kyi zab gnad las brtsams pa'i brjod bya rgya mtsho ltar zab cing / sgo srog lus rnams gang las kyang khyad thon nas lhun po ltar bajid pa/ chos dang srid kyi lo rgyus dang mngon brjod sdeb spyor dang skad shan sbyar sna tshogs 'brel ba lha'i rkang 'thung spel ba bzhin lta ba dang nyan pa po'i mig dang yid 'phrog par byed/ de ltar gsung gi yon tan la brten nas kyang mi ldog pa'i dad pa shugs drag 4 skyes pas gdul 258
'phrin yig gi rnam bzhag blo gsal 'tsheng mdzes/bya rnams kyi rgyud la mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi rgyu skar phan bde'i 'od zer 'bar ba'i srid pa'i mkha' ngos gzugs can dus gsum gyi skye dgu dang] rgyal ba sras bcas kyi bar du nyi ma dang / zla ba ltar gsal bar byung ba lags so/ /yig bskur byung tshul gyi rnam bzhag mdor bsdu| k+ham̐ /shā dī dzār+sha dīlha( lhan r+sha/ gi/ brda chad ji ltar yod pa ni/ bshes springs sogs ltar na 'phags yul gyi yig bskur de dag phal che ba la/ deng sang gi 'di dag dang 'dra ba'i bskur ba dngad bskur mkhan gyi ming sogs mgor bris nas de'i mjug nas 'thebs sam mtho dman byed par ma mngon te/ de yang snyan ngag chen po dang cha 'dra ba shis brjod phyag dngos po nges bstan gsum gang rung gi sgo dang / brjod bya sde bzhi ci rigs las brtsams pa'i srog dang ldan pa/ lus ldeb sbyongar stan ngag gi bcad lhug spel sogs ci rigs byas pa/ mjug tu bsdo ba rtsogs thog mtha' bar du dge ba'i tshig sbyongar can zugag bu'i byang bu la bris te glegs bam byas pa dang / lhadzig dril byas pa tsam las nyis nyebs sum ltebs sogs kyi nges bzung med pa 'dra zhes kha cig zer ba de ltar du sems la/ yang rnam pa gcig tu na/ krong khyer pā ṭā liṃ bu dra'i rgyal po mya ngan med kyi btsun mo gser gyi 'phreng ldan ma zhes pas rgyal po'i nad gso dka' ba zhig gsos pas zhag bdun la rgyal srid 'dzin pa'i mchog bsrung ba gnang ba dang/ rgyal po de'i dī gā dz+nyo ༵༵ /shā ñtsā ༵ rnyi sdi dzo dīsna )pa gh+nā paX sbrispri ṭ+wāṃ ñtsā dz+nyo sbyo lha spya rnyi palha ༵ be+e dā gnyis par song ba de dbyung slad/ grong khyer rdo lasag gi rgyal po glang po'i rna ba la/ rgyal po myangan med pa'i yig brdzun bskur tshul/ dpag bsam 'khri shing las/ swa nyi grong khyer pā sprali pu tra las mtshungs pa med pa'i g.yul la dpa' bas yang dag par thob pa/ rgya mtsho mtha' dag gi mtshams 259
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum kam+p+raṃ (lha/shā spra r+sha ༷ spyu sna ༵ ༵ ṭ+wāṃ dwo brardzu tsho zlopa dī ( hūm̐ ṭ+wāṃ pa~X dī ༵ padzo k+ṣiṃ (shā ñtsha gh+nā paX pa byin pa/ dgra po'i gzi byin nyams par byed cing mi dga' ba rnams kyi dga' ma'i rtsedaga'i dmod pa bzhin du gyur pa/ dri ma med pa'i nor bu'i rkang stegs mtha' yas pa'i rgyal phran gyis rab tu btud pa'i bzhin gyi pad+ma'i gzugs can snod gcig tu byas pa/ legs byas dge bas pad+mo rnam par rgyas bar byed pa'i nyin mo'i dbang phyug rtul phod dang brtson 'grus dang spro ba chen 4 rab tu rgyas pa'i nags tshal gyi gdong lnga pa dpal ldan mya ngan med pas rdo lasdog gi dbang po dpal glang po'i rna ba la yangadag par rtogs par byed pa gdo ltaste/ bdag gi bu'i bzhin dang ldan pa'i dag khrel med cingangan ba'i rgyud pa la byams la yongs su skrog ba'i sbyod pa can/ mi gtsang zhing bstan bcos la sdang ba/ mig gi mda' brgya pha'i chung ma la mngon par sred pa'i dug gi snod du byed pa/ sdig pa'i rjes su mthun pa'i gzugs dngarga lang tsho dang / spro ba dang] rtul phod dang ldan pa/ skye 4 mi'i lag 'gro 'di'i mig gi nor bu rab tu phyung lte gos dang bral bar bskrad par mdzod cig /ces bskur bar bshad pa dang] rgyal 4 gzugs can snying pos rgyal 4 u tra ya na la sming yig bskur tshul/ dpag bsam 'khri shing las/ bde bar gshegs pa'i zhabs pad bkod pa'i bsod nams nyer gyur pa/ /skabs gsum grong gi khyad par rgya che ma ga lha yul nas/ /dge ba byams pa'i gzugs can sa yi bdag po gzugs can snying / /chos kyi gnyen gyis sa gzhi'i rig le khyod la rab smras pa/ /zhes sogs ltar na tshig ris 'di dag ji bzhin bris pa min yod kyang 'di dag gi don can re bskur bar gsal bas/ bskur yul dang bskur mkhan su che ba de mgo la bris pa na 'drubs dregags kyang 'amad dam snyam ste sngar gyi bshes spring serdzogs la de ltar med kyang zhal gdams dang dris lan yi ger bris spru tsho tshur du bskur ba tsam yin pas 'phrin 260
'phrin yig gi rnam bzhag blo gsal 'tsheng ma sa/yig dkyus ma dang cung mi yo ba dang mi 'gal tshul yang dbyad na shes so/ /snga dus de dag gi tshe rgya ci 'dra bas spras snyam na/ rje bdag nyid chen pos byang sems chen 4 sgra dbyangs sras po'i rtogs brjod dpag bsam nyakhri shing las/ rigs kyi bu/ 'di'i nang na de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bzod pa gcig pa'i lam shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i glegs bam bzhugs so/ /zhes pa nas/ rtag tu ngus smras pa/ de ltar na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i glegs bam bdag la ston cig /brgya byin gyis smras pa/ rigs kyi bu de yang gser gyi glegs bam la baiḍūr+ya bzhu bas bris pa 'phags pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen 4 chos 'phags kyis rgya rim pa bdun gyis btab nas bzhag ste/ nged kyis khyod la bstan dka'o zhes dang / rgya rim pa bdun byas tshul ni/ de nyid las bzhu bas bris pa rnyed par dka' don che ba nyid kyi migbyang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen 4 chos 'phags kyis sku rags bdun bdun gyis shin tu dam par bcings nas mdud pa'i gnas bdun la rang ming gi rgya rim pa bdun gyis btab nas bzhag pas nged kyis khyod la shin tu bstan par dka'o/ /zhes dngan 'grel pa snying 4 mchog las glegs thag gis rim pa bdun du bcings pa'i mdud pa'i sa mtshams so sor rang ming gis rgya byas par bshad pa dang] lung gzhi'i 'tsho byed gzhon nu'i byung ba las yang khye'ur gyur na seng ras lade skon la sor gdub kyi rgya mgul du thogs langa'i drung du dkri zhig ces dang/ rgya cher 'grel du lung bkod pa las/ sor gdub rgya yang bcang bar mi bya'o/ /zhes dang / dpag bsam nyakhri shing las/ gzugs can snying po'i lag rtags can/ /spring yig thang lnga'i sngon byung ba/ /mi bdag u tra ya na ni/ /rab tu dga' bas rang gis klag /ces gsungs pa ltar skabs 'di'i rgya dang phyag rgya dang lag rtags rnams go don gcig pas 'de dag ni rgya la rang ming gis spras pa can la rgya sprus pa can re phal cher khyim pa lugs kyi rgya byed tshul lo/ /rab byung la ni de 261
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum kabzhin gshegs pas gnang pa ni/ 'dul ba mdo rtsalas/ rgya bcad par bya'o/ /gdags su mi rung pa'o/ /re nye 'am/ zangs sam/ ra gan nam/ khar ba'am/ rgya skyegs kyi tshig ma'am/ shing ngam/rdo'am/ ba so'am/ rwa dag las byas pa'o/ /rtagasani dge 'dun gyi la'idabus su gshor lo gnyis su ri dwags 'og tu gtsug lag khang gi bdag po'i rang ming dri'o/ /gang zag la ni rus pa'i keng rus sam/ mgo'i zod pa'am/ zhesadang / rgya cher 'grel las mdo dang bcas te bshad pa ni/ de nyid las/ 'dir gzhung ni gzhung gcig las dge slong gis gser la sogs pa las byas pa'i rgya bcang bar mi bya'o/ /sor gdub rgya yang mi bya'o/ /'di ltar rgya ni rnam pa lnga ste/ ra gan las byas pa dang/ zangs las byas pa dang/ khar ba las byas pa dang/ ba so las byas pa dang/ rwa las byas pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gzhung kha cig las/ rgya rnam pa brgyad ṭo re nye dang/ zangs dang/ra gan dang / khar ba dang / rgya skyegs kyi tshig ma dang / shing dang / sa las byas pa bcad par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ de yang rin 4 che las gzhan pa'i rdzas kyi dpe yin no/ /zhes dngan dge 'dun gyi rgya la ni/ rtags 'de ltar byas te/ dbus su gangor lo bris nas ngos gnyis su ri dwags bri bar bya zhing / gangor lo'i 'og tu gtsug lag khang gi bdag po'i ming bri bar bya'o/ /zhes dang] de ltar bri dgos pa/ṭīka chen rin chen 'phreng ba las/ dge slong gis rgya bcad par bya'o/ /rnam pa ji lta bu zhe na/ rgyan gyi tha snyad gdags su mi rung ba'o/ /rgyu gang las byas pa zhe na/ ro snya'am/ zangs sam/ ra gan nam/ khar ba'am/ rgya skyegs kyi tshig ma'am/ shing ngam/ rdo 'am/ sa'am/ ba so'am/ rwa dag las byas pa'o/ /rtags ni/ dge 'dun gyi rgya la ni/ dgor zhing spyad pa'i brdar dbus su gshor lo/ gang zag gis ris su bcad du mi rung ba mtshon pa ngos gnyis su ri dwags/ sbyin bdag dga' ba'i phyir 'og tu gtsug lag khang gi bdag po'i ming bri'o/ /gang zag gi rgya la ni kun tu skyo ba skyed pa'i phyir rus pa'i keng rus sam/ mgo bo'i cad 262
'phrin yig gi rnam bzhag blo gsal 'tsheng mdzes/pa bri bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i rkeng rus dang 'od tshal bris pa'i dgos pa skyo ba skyed par ma zad bsod nyams kyi mtha' lasag ched du'ang yinate/ mdzod las/ keng rus chags bcas thams cad la/ /zhes gsungs pa'i rigs pa sbyar du rung ba'i pyir te/ spyod yul yongs su dag pa'i mdo sogs kyis kyang shes so/ /'dir ni rab byung gi rtags la rang gi ming 'bri bar ma bshad do/ /'o na gtsug lag khang gi bdag po'i ming 'bri bar bshad pa mi 'gal lam snyam na/ de ni gtsug lag khang gi sbyin bdag ste/ khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin lta bu'o/ /mgon med zas sbyon gyis kun rwa'i bdag po byed pa'i phyir ro/ /gso grang gi dus su gtsug lag khang gi bdag 4 dang] gtsug lag khang gi lha'i tshigs bcad re bskul bas kyang shes dgos pa'i phyis 'o na ston pas rab byung gi ming gis rgya byed par ma mdzad pa la dgos pa'am rgyu mtshan yod dam zhe na/ shin tu yod de/ ma gus pa slong ba dang / pha rol gyi bsod nams la mi gnod par bya ba sogs kyi ched yin pa'i phyid skyabs 'gro yan lag drug pa las/ sku gzugs tshigs su bcad padang/ /lhan pa ser 4 btab pa la/ /dad mos sgo nas ston pa btags/ /zhes 〈snags dang] lam rim las/ ston pa rin po che dang/ rnal 'byor pa chen 4 lhan ba ser por 'goms pa'i sar yod pa nga/nga mi 'goms par sprugs nas gtsang sar skyel ba'i phyag len la bslab nye/ rang nyid dkon mchog la ji tsam gus pa de tsam du 'gro ba rnams kyang rang la ches cher gus par 'gyur te/ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ci 'dra ba yis las byas pa/ /'bras bu de 'dra thob par 'gyug /zhes shes byed dang bcas te na bza'i ras ma la'ang 'goms mi nyan par bshad na/ de'i mtshan la ltaci smos te/ sa'i snying po'i mdo las/ tshangs pa chen po ganganga'i pyir rab tu byung ba tshul khrims 'chal ba dge slong stong pa lta bu shing rul ba lta bur gyur ba zhes pa nas/ nyon mongs pa sna tshogs kyis gshegs pa ltang bas phan pa yin yang/ tshul khrims 'chal ba'i sdig pa spyod pa'idage slong dede'i 263
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum katshe ltathams cad dang n+ma rnams kyi bar dang bsod nams kyi gter dag gi bar gyi ston padang dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin no/ /zhes sogs kyis rab byung tsam dag ma dag gang yin kyang rgyal pos kyang chos bzhin chad pa gcod mi rung na chos min pas lta ci smos par bshad nas/ yang de nyid las/ su nga'i phyir rab tu byung ba nod du gyur ram snod du ma gyur kyang rung ba rnams la gang dag 'tshe ba de dag thams cad ni dus gsum du gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad la shin tu nyes pa dang bcas pa yin no/ /dge ba'i rtsab chad pa dngan rgyud tshig pa dang tshim pa med par gzhol ba yin no/ /zhesadangaka 'do ltaste/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i gos ngur smrig pa 'de ni thar pa'i rgyal mtshan yin no/ /zhesadang] de bzhin du nam snying gi mdo sogs las kyang bshad pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i cha byad 'dzin pa'i sa rdo la'ang brnyas mi nyan na de'i cha byad 'dzin pa'i sems ldan ltaci smos pas/ ma brtags ma dbyad par tsham tshom du 'jug ga la rigs la/ gzhan yang gtam rgyud la'ang de'i ming dang mtshan ma dran pa'i phan yon sogs kyang 'ar sbyar bar bya'o/ /yang bod gangs can gyi ldongs lan dang / chen po hor gyi yul sogs su bla chen dang / rgyal rigs rnams kyi gser gyi tham ka dang / tsa dan sogs kyi rgyu khyad 'phags las grub pa'i tham ka ltag mge3stor bu gsum pa sogs kyis sbras pani 'dzin pa'i srol zhigadar te/ dper na gong ma sa chen rgyal po la tshe ring byas phul bas tshe ring gnam gyi she mong du grags pa'i shel tham dang/ 'gro ma〈snan chos rgyal 'phags pag se chen rgyal sas/ gnam gyi 'og sa'i stengan/ rgya gar lha'i sras 4/ sprul pa'i sangs rgyas yi ge rtsome mi/ rgyal khams 'chams 'jags su 'jug pa 4/ gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta 'phags pa tī shrī zhes mtshan gsesnal nas phul ba'i shel tham gling drug ma dang/ de mtshungs su gong ma rgyal pos rang cag gi rnam 'drin rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mkhyen ba6nus pa ma lus pa 'dus pa'i ngo 'o rgyal ba thams cad kyi 264
'phrin yig gi rnam bzhag blo gsal 'tsheng mdzes/bdag 4 rin 4 che lagang/ nub kyi lha gnas chesadage ba bde bar gnas pa'i sangs rgyas bka' lung / gnam 'og gi skye 'gro thams cad bstan pa gcig tu gyur pa 'gyur med rdo rje 'chang rgya mtsho'i bla ma zhes mtshan rgya hor bod gsum gyi yi sga sum gshib tu yod pa'i 'ja' sa phul bar mdzad pa dang/ gzhanayang rgyal po'i tham ka bcu gnyis las/ dang 4 hung thag tsi ba'u 'de bla ma'i las lnga'i lo sacig gi nang du gnam sa'i bstod pa'i yi ge las gzhan la mi rgyag/hūṃ n+da ba'u 'di bla ma'i las lnga'i 'ja' sa thams cad la'ang rgyag/chi ku'u ci ba'u 'di wang ku shrī rnams kyi 'ja' sa la rgyag /ñtsha ldan zan ba'u 'di khrims ra thams cad la rgyag /ces rgya nag gi yig tshang las 'byung la/ dbyibs bla mdang rgyal po che chung sogs kyi tham rtags che chung gnyis ka gru bzhi btsun mo sogs kyi tham ka sgor mo byed pa zhig rgya nag gi lugs yin par grags rtso/'o na/ dam pa de dag gis gser tham sogs 'dzin pa lung dang mi 'gal lam zhe na mi 'gal te/ 'dul bar gang zag khyad par can 'dod zhen med pa la/ khang mig lnga brgya pa dang / gos 'bum ri ba yang gnang la/ byang sa sogs las/ dge slong byang sems la de bas kyang ches che ba mang ṭo gnang bas so/ /de yang dam pa de dag gi gser tham rnams gdul bya de dag tshogs rdzogs ched yin pas/thabs mkhas bla na med pa kho na'o/ /'on kyang rab byung rnams kyis 'dul ba'i gzhung gi tshig zin ltar tham ka ci'i phyir ma byas snyam na/ sngadar gyi dus su chosadar tsam yin gyi zhib 4 ga la yod/pyi dar gyi dus su'ang lag len zhib 4 dka' tsam byung bar mngon la/ de tsam du ma zad chos kyi rgyal po rje rgyal ba gnyis pa ma phebs yan chad du chos gos rnam gsum dang gding ba rnams kyi tshal bu sogs kyang dge bshes chen por rlom pa dag gis kyang mi shes pa rnam thar chen modang/mkhas pa dag gi gsung las thos rtso/ /rje bdag nyid chen po phebs rjes su'ang tham ka de ltar ma mdzad pa ni gtsug lag khang gi bdag po'i ming bris na sgyin bdag gzhan gyis zagadogadang keng 265
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum karus dang thod pa bris na/ brgya pa las/ 'jig rten kun la 'chi bdag sgra/ /ji ltar 'jigs pa bskyed gyur yang/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar skrag pa dang rnam rtog skyed dogs nas ma mdzad par snang bar sems la/denas brgya pa las/ ji ltar kla klo skad gzhan gyis/ /bzung bar mi nusade bzhin pu 'dzig rten pa yi ma gtogs pag /'jig rten bzung bar nus ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yul dus gnas skabs de'i gang zag gi blo dang mtsham pa gang legs byed pa las mtha' gcig tu chos 'jig rten gang la'ang 'de khon byed kyinges bzung ga la nus te/ mkhyen brtsenas gsum gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis kyang chos sna tshogs gsungs dgos pa byung 'dug pa'i phyir na 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi gsung las 'dir sems can rnams kyi mos pa sna tshogs kyi dbang gis thams cad mkhyen pa'i skad du ma dang / bzhugs pa'i gnas du mdang]gsol ba 'dobs pa 4 du ma dang] chos ston pa du ma yin no/ /zhes dang/ mdo las/ 'gro ba bh+yod pa'i sgo rnams ji snyed pa/ /de snyed chos kyi sgo la rab zhugs te/ /de dag kun tu rnam thar sgo dag nas/ /bsam pa ji bzhin 'dzig lten sems can 'dul/ /zhes dang/de bzhin du/ rin chen 'tsheng ba las/ brda sprod slob mkhan gyi dpe dang / lang gshegs las/ nad pa sman ster tshul gyidapes las ba'i khamasadang bstunanas ston par gsungs padang/ston pa'i zhalanas kyang/sngag rtenangadang rtsod kying la)ga rten dang mi rtsod de/ṇ+ḍag rten nayod pade ngas kyang khas len gsungs pa sogasadang/ mdor na chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa'ang gdul bya'i dbang gis yen tshul sogs lung rigs mtha' yas pa'i phyir ro/ /de dag gi brda chad ji ltar yod pa mtshon tsam bshad zin to/ /༈ gnyis pa deng dus phyag len la 'debs tshul bshad pa la/ phar bskur tshul dang / tshur byung ba'i lan dang / yig rgya sogs kyi rnam bzhag dang / pyi nang gi tham rtags 'debs tshul 266
'phrin yig gi rnam bzhag blo gsal 'pheng mdzes/dang / zhar la thog mtha' bar du dge ba'i chos la gnas par gdams pa dang lnga'o/ de yang 'de dag gi rnam bzhag phal cher 'brom gyis mdzad pa'i lhastog gcig ma/ 'gro mgon 'phags pas mdzad zer ba'i le'u bzhi pa sogs dang / rang gi bla ma dam pa rigs brgya'i khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po'i zhabs drung nas phyag len ji ltar mdzad pa rnams la brten nas cung zad spro bar byas na/ 'og mar yul gyi ma'o dman gyi rnam bzhag shes na khyad che bas de cung zad tsam brjod na/ sbyor lung rtogs kyis mtho ba/ bslab bcas kyis mtho ba/ rigs rus kyis mtho ba/ stobs mnga' thang gis mtho ba sogs du ma zhig yod pa las/ chos kyi lugs ltar na/ mdo las/ rigs rus stobs mi gtso yon tan kho na gtso zhes bshad pas/ rang re chos byed pa rnams kyis 'di kho na ltar bya dgos pas/ lung rtogs dang] bslab bcas kyis mtho ba la che bar lajug dgos la/ phan btags pa'i zhing pha ma dag kyang 'de skabs kyi che bar 'os so/ /'jig rten pa ltar na/rigs rgyud stobs mnga' thang sogs gtso che bas/ de la rigs kyi rim pa ni/ bram ze/ rgyal rigs/ rje rigs/ dmangs rigs bzhi yod cing mtho dman yang de ltar yin la/ gzhan yang dang po rigs gzhan yin pa phyis bsod nams sogs kyis rgyal rigs su gyur pa'ang yod pa'i phyig de yang bya ba'i cha nas rigs dang / skyed byed pha'i sa 'on las rus pa 'byung bas pha'i sa 'on gyi cha nas rus pa lasdog ste/ brgya ba las/ 'tsho ba'i thabs dngos cog la yang] /'jig rten na ni rigs zhes bsnyad/ /ces gsungs/ 'od 'dir bram ze'i rigs dngos gnas pa med kyang grub pa brnyes pa'i sngags rgyud lta bu'i gdung che ba dag la de'i dod shin tu rung ngo] /'od 'di'i bla ma lde dpon gyi che chung sogs ni yul 'dir sdod pa dag kho na la mkho yang / byang phyogs pa dag la ches mi mkho bas ma bris 〈sna/ /rang rang gi yul mi che chung yul lugs dang bstun pas rgyal 4 sogs kyi khyad par shes dgos so/ /rigs zhes bsnyad/ ces dang / brgya pa'i 'grel 267
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum kapas ji ltar gser gyi sbyi blugs/ lan nyid du gzhan gyi gnas skabs de dang der gyur dbyibs kyang gnas skabs su thadad pas thadad par gyur pade bzhin du 'jig rten las bshad pa ma byas shing brje ba'ang yin no/ /zhes gsungs te/ bram ze mar ka ṭa'i gser gyi sgyi blugs bcol ba dper bya'o/ /'di la sgyir dbyangs can sa 'odzin bdag po'i zlos gar rgyal po dge ba'i dbang pos mu tig nyakhri shing gi rtogs pa brjod pas de nas de yi gtam gyis de/ /sngar skyes dge ba rgyas pa thob/ /bcom ldan slad du gsol ba yi/ /spring yigade dag rnams la bskud /zhes pa dngakabshes spring slob spring ka ni na'i spring yig ces 〈snags la dpag na/ 'phags yul du springs pa dang bskur zhes tsam gyis shin tu mtho ba zhig gisadama' ba kho na la bskur tshul du mi 'gyur kyanganbod gangs can gyi ldongs 'der ni/ 'gro mgon chos kyi rgyal 4 sogs kyis/ rgya hor rgyal pos bzlo ba thob/ /bod kyi rgyal pos springs pa thob/ /rdzal 'byor ba yis 'di lta ste/ /brgya stong dpon gyis bskur ba thob/ /ces springs pa dang bzlo ba dang bskur ba rnams chen po kho nas byed cing /deng dus ci rigs par phyag len la'ang 'debs kyin 'dug pas/ mdo tsam smras na sgyir kha ba can/ de'i nanganas rang re byang phyogs pa rnams kyi me tog 'og pa'i lha ni las mgon phyagan pad+ma rgyal ba'i dbang po'i sku'i rabasadagasan la/ 'de nyid la gsang ba gsum gyi rnam par thar pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa tsam yod cing shun mong ba'i rnam thar la'ang 'od kyi yul du byon pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gis mtshon pa'i bka' bstan bcos 'gyur ro cog gi lungadabang khrid mnangag dusadeng sang bzhugs pa rnams ma lus par mnga' zhing / bcu phrag gi rig pa'i gnas kyi shes bya ma lus pa rig pa ltaci smos/gdul byadabang po rno 'bring thams cad la'ang lag mthil gyi shing tog ltar ston zhing/ thun mongadang thun mong masan pa'i bslab pa gsum gyis ches cher phyug pas dus gsum gyi mkhas grub kyi yang rmethob la/ mkhyen brtsemathu nus gang la'ang rgyal ba thams 268
'phrin yig gi rnam bzhag blo gsal 'tsheng mdzes/cad gcig tu byas pa'i do zlar 'os pa/ tha na phyag gis reg tsam mdzad pa'i me tog kyang yul gang du phebs pa de dag tu bkra shis kyi dge mtshan nyi ma ltar 'bar bas mkhas zlun thams cad la mngon sum du snang bar gyur nas chos srid gnyis lnga'i cha nas ltadang mi'i bla mar gyur pa 'de nyid kyis bka' 71ga gnang tshe sgo yig chen mo ltarasag mgo shin tu che ba'i sne ring por zen pa'i 'og tu yi ge rnams tshud par byas la/ che brjod gang rgyas dang 'brel ba'i mtshan mthar gang gi bka' 'am lung zhes bris te/ lhag 'phreng de bzhag la 'phebs shin tu che ba byas/ lungangam bka' zhes pa'i 'og tu lhag ma'i yig mgo tshud nges kyi sar bskur yul/ dper na 'dzam gling yangs pa'i khong gshod kyi che rgu drag zhan rnams la springs pa zhes pa lta bu gcig shin tu 'thob/ de bzhin du gnam sa'i dbang phyug sa'i tshangs pa lde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho pa lan nyid sogs kyis kyang yig mgo shin tu che ba'i spring yig 'argab la/ de'i 'og tu de bzhin du rgya dang hor 'od kyi chos rgyal gshor los bsgyur ba chen 4 dag gis ni/ yig mgo che ba sogs sngar ltar la bzlo ba zhes 'thob ste/ gong ma rgyal po lta bus bka' 77ga gnang tshe yig mgo yi ge kun che zhing che brjod dang 'brel ba'i mtshan mthar gang gi lung zhes bris/ 'thebs chen po byas nas bskur yul gyi ming gi smos te khyod gong zhagad la bzlo ba zhes bya la gzhan 'dra/ de bzhin du rnal 'phyor gyi dbang phyug chen po sngar gyi rwa lo dang] sa skya gong ma sogs dang / phyis kyi bstan pa'i bdag 4 rje rgyal ba gnyis pa yab sras de'i gdan sar phebs rim dang / 'od kha ba can gyi chos lde rnams kyi gtsug rgyan rje btsun tsong kha pa chen po'i gdan sa chen ṭo/ dpal ldan 'bras spungs phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal pa'i gling / mkhas mang gi bsnyi gnas dpal ldan se ra theg chen gling ste gdan sa phan tshun gnyis dang / bkra shis lhun kho serdzogs kyi gdan sa pa dag gis kyang spring yig gnang ba 'thob ste/ rgya gar du yang dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub slob 269
kun mkhyen gsung 'grum kadpon chen 4 ma ti 6 hra mkhas pa chen po tsan dra go mi sogs kyis spring yig bskur ba dang /der ma zad yang na yig mgo shin tu che ba'i yig mgo'i sne ring por 'then cing / mtshan che brjod dang bcas mthar 'be+ebs byas/ khyed rnams kyis nges rgyur 'di lta ste'am 'di ltar bya rigs te rnal 'byor ba yis 'di lta ste/ zhes gsungs pas kyang / 'grub pa'i phyig khams kyi rgyal sor grags pa r+ṇi dpon stong dpon brgya dpon dag dang yul de'i dpon po dag gis rang mtshungs 〈snags gzhan la yi ge bskur na 'di dag gi yig mgo dang yi ge che tsam la gnas rang ming gi rjes su de dag gi yi ge che tsam la 'bebs mtshon par byas nas/ pha rol 4 che ge la bskur ba zhes thob par bshad snang la/ deng sang rang gi dmangs mnga' 'og sogs la thad bris sogs mdzad srol snang ngo / /de dag ni chen 4 dag gis phar yi ge bskur tshul lo/ /chen 4 rnams la slob ma thegags kyis yi ge ji ltar 'bul tshul ni/ 'brom sesnags kyis/ chos 'brel bla ma slob dpon dang/ khyi skor stong dpon bdag po dang] /dbus gtsang rje dpon pha ma sogs/ /rang nyid phyag 'bul byed pa la/ /zhabs drung du ni zhu ba thob/ /gong 'og sor brgyad tsam zhig s+pha /zhes gsungs pa ltar chos kyi 'breladabang sogs zhus pa'i bla mdang] bka' sde snod sogs slob pa'i slob dpon dang / de dag min kyang lung rtogs kyis thugs rgyud rab tu phyug pa mthong thos dran pas kyang mngon mtho nges legs kyi sa bon 'debs pa'i skyes chen dam pa rnams dang / 'jig rten gyi stobs kyis na'or los bsgyur ba dang / de 'og gi r+ṇi skor stong dngon sogs dang / rang gi pha ma dre gas la yi ge 'bul tshul ni yig ma〈sna shin tu chung la/ yi ge'ang phra 〈sna byas nas/ che brjod ci rigs dang 'brel ba'i mtshan mthar phyag tu 'bul mi nus pa'i gus pa mtshon byed du zhabs drung du'am/ zhabs pad rin po che'i drung du'am/ zhabs stegs rin chen 'bar ba'i drung du'am/ zhabs rten gsar ba'i drung du zhes bris nas/ de lhag 'tsheng de bskyur nas/ bar du sor 270
'grin yig gi rnam bzhag blo gsal 'phreng mjes/brgyad sogs 'ong ba'i de 'og du chud nges kyi sar zhu ba zhes sam/ sor bcus thal mo skyar te gus pa chen yos zhu ba/deng legs byas brgya phrag gis bskrun pa'i sku'idakyil ga'or zhes pa ltabu'i sku sogs brjod pa'i sngon du yi ge'i steng ngos su che man bya zhing / bsnyun 'dri yang bla ma sogs la chos bstun gyi bsnyun 'dri dang / rgyal po sogs la 'dzig rten gyi stobs sogs kyi bstun 'dri dang] sher pyin stong phrag brgya pa las/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'od zer kun nas 'byung bas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i rin chen 'byung gnas bcom ldan 'das la bsnyun mi mnga'a'am/ gnod pa ma mchis sam/ zo mdog bde'am/ sku nyams dang ldan nam/ bde ba dang dgyes par rgyud dam/ zhes 'odri ste/ zhes gsungs pa ltag sku la nyer 'tshe'i dri ma dang bral zhing phun tshogs legs byas skya sgo brgya la skye dgu 'god bzhin pa'i dbyings nas bzhugs lags sam zhes lugs gnyis gang byas kyang lngasnag /mi shes pa'i rigs kyis tshig spya n+d+ra sbyo〈 sna pyā /(3 lhas ma ts+tsha sta 〉pa ༵༵ga snar+shar+sha spri pa(( pasnang rnyis pasna pazhi/ / du gzhan la'ang rgyur zhing] chen 4 dag la 'bul skabs/ 'der phran bu'ang bde bar mchis lta bu las rang gi gnas tshul rgyas par mi byed la/ ched du zhu ba 'bul rgyu zhes dngos don gang yin smras rjes/ slad nas kyang phebs 'os gang gā'i rgyun bzhin zhu'am/ chu bo'i rgyun bzhin nam/ nyal 'gro'i rgyun bzhin nam/dza shu'i bu mo'i rgyun bzhin nag sa: rgyun bzhinanam/ pak+ṣu'i rgyun bzhin zhu zhes dang / spyan ras kyis gzigs pa mtshon pagarten 'di dang 'di zhes bya ba dang bcas/ zla ba che ge mo dang] tshes grangs che ge mo la gnas che ge mo nas phul ba'i zhes dang/ zhu yig ces pa cung de las dma' bar byas la 'bri zhing / de la yang lo skor gyis 'gro dgos pa'i yul yin 271
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum kana lo'i ming yang bris na legs la/ lo ming 'bri na rab byung rnam 'byung dkar po dang / /zhes sogs sam me stag gi lo la serdzogs pa gang rungadang/ zla ba'i ming 'bri na/ hor gcod kyi gdams pa nyams su len tshul/da༅༅/ /gcod kyi gdams pa gdan thog gcig tu dril nas nyams su len tshul bzhugs seng/ /na po de ba ḍā gi ni ye/ gcod kyi gdams pa gdan 'og gcig tu dril nas skras su len bar ladod pas skyabs yulagasal rabasani/phaṭaḥmadun gyi nam mkhar seng khri'i pad zla'i stengan /bla ma yum chen lab slon dbyer med la/ /rtsabargyud bla ma mchog gsum yi dam dang] /mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs kyis bskor nas bzhugs/ /phaṭa bdag sogs 'gro rnams byang chub snying po'i bag /bla ma dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'chi/ /'gro kun 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las bsgral te/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa la 'god par lga /lan gsum brjod/phaṭa rang gi sgyi 'or pad+ma nyi zla'i steng] /rtsaba'i bla ma lab snyon dbyer med la/ /rnam pa rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /dmar mo khro 'dzum phyag g.yas gri gug 'phyad /g.yon pa thod khrag kha ṭ+wāṃ mchan khung brten/ /gcer mo skro krol thod skam dbu rgyan dang / /thod rlon do shal rus brgyan g.yas brkyangs bzhugs/ /phaṭa ston pa sangs rgyas rje btsun 'jam dbyangs dang / /ar+ya dre ba pha cig dam pa sogs/ /pha rgyud thabs kyi brgyud pa'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud pyin gyis slobs/ /yum chen sher phyin rje btsun slol ma dang / /su kha sirnyi ma cig lab slon sogs/ /ma rgyud shes rab brgyud pa'i bla ma 297
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum kala/ /gsol ba 'debs rtso bdag rgyud byin gyis slobs/ /rje btsun 'jam dbyangs dpa' bo rdo rje dang/ /blo bzang grags pa 'jam dpal rgya mtsho sogs/ /nye brgyud byin rlabs brgyud pa'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs sodzi/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus rdo rje rnal 'phyor dngad /yum chen lab sgron nyid la gsol ba 'debs/ /mi rtag 'chi ba dran par byin gyis rlobs/ /tshe 'di blo yi thongs parazlo/ /bdag 'edzin rtsad nas chod par zlo/ /nyams dang rtogs pa 'char bar zlo/ /de ltar gsol ba btab pas rje btsun ma'i/ /sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs rang nyid kyi/ /sgyi gtsug nas zhugs lus gang sgrib kun dag/shel sgo nga ltar dkar dbu ma 'da' sdug tsam/ /yar sna tshangs bug mar sna lte 'og r+ya /sor bzhi'i tshad du rang sems bya sgong tsam/ /dkar 'tsher 'od kyi phung po 'phar la khad/ /bla ma'i zugs spur 'pho snyam 'dun pa bzung / /phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ drag tu brjod pas sgyi por rgyangs te can/ /rje btsun rnal 'gyor ma yi thugs shar rim/ /rang lus rnying pa shing sdong bcad pa bzhin/ /langs te 'gyel bas stong gsum khyon gang ba'i/ /rang sems mkha' 'gro dmar mo'i sgra gug gis/ /sum zag nas bzung rkang lag 〉bar gshag /sha khrag dmar nyil glenang ba'i dwangs ma rnams/ /'dod yon lnga ldan bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyus /phaṭa rtsabargyud bla ma yi dam zhi khro si/dpa' 'odapa' mo chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs/ /dkon mchog srid zhu'i mgron la mchod pa 'bul/ /mgon 4 yon tan mgron la gtang rag gtong / /rigs drug snying rje'i mgron la sbyin pa gtong/ /gnod byed lan chags mgron la rba lon 'jal/ /gnod pa'i sems zhi phan pa'i sems ldan shog/phaṭa phaṭa/ rtsigs ma sha dang rus pa'i ri rab dngan /khrag chen rgya mtshor gyur pas stong gsum gang / /rang sems mkha' 'gro phyag gnyis sgra gug dang / /thod khrag 'dzin pas phyogs bcur 'a4da rgyangs sgrogs/ /phaṭa phaṭa/ mtho ba srid pa'i rtsemo man chad dang] /dma' ba na rag dmyal ba yan chad na/ /gnas pa'i snang srid lha 'dri che dgu dang / /gnyan dgu dregs dgu thams 298
gcod kyi gdams pa nyams su len tshul/cad 'dir tshogs shig /phaṭa lha klu btsan bdud ma mo gzhin rje dang1 /rgyal po bsen mo dam sri rbad 'dri'i rigs/ /gnod 'tshe'e sems ldan yod do cog rnams kun/ /myur du 'dir 'tshogs 'dir 'dus 'dir byon cig /phaṭa sgyu ma'i lus lan sgyir gyis 'gro drug dang / /yang dgos pha ma rtsaba'i bla ma yi/ /sku yi glud du 'bul 'o( gnod byed kun/ /sha la dga' ba rnams kyis sha zo zhig/khrag la dga' ba rnams kyis khrag 'thung zhig/rus pa ladaga' lta'adres rus pa mus /don snying nang rol rtsargyus klad pa sogs/ /ma lus lus pa med par zo zhig 'thung / /khyer zhig rol cig snoms shig dgyes par mdzod/ /phaṭa phaṭa/ pags pa dum bur gtubs pa 'jig rten dang / /'jig rten las 'das mkho dgu'i yo byad du/ /gyur pa snang srid lha 'dre so so ru/ /gangs dkar rtsedang ri rab nam mkha'i mthong / /rgya mtsho'i gting dang gling dang gling phran brgyad/ /rang rang gnas su bya brgya 'ur gcig gis/ /bdas pa bzhin du rang gnas song bar gyur/ /phaṭa phaṭa/ sbyin bya sbyin yul sgyin pa gtong mkhan rnams/ /ming brdas bzhag tsam ma gtogs yul steng nas/ /grub pa med phyir dngor 'das chos rnams kun/ /gang snang rmi lam yu la gyi skyes bu bzhin/ bar 'ar sher snying shon don la maṇ+ḍa bar bag/dkon mchog mchod pas mnyes gyur cig/dam can zugasadam skong gyur cig/rigs drug 'dod pa tshim gyur cig/sha dngon sdig sgrib dag gyur cig /'byung po gang dag 'dir ni lhags gyur te/ /sa'am 'on te bar snang 'khod kyang rung / /skye dgu rnams la rtag tu byams byed cing / /nyin dang mtshan du chos la spyod par shog/ces sogs brdzo smon gyis rgyas lanabs parabya'o//ces pa 'dini shākya'idage slong 7lan+damadabyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rjes bkrashis dmil nas sbyar ba'o// // ronulha//299

rab gnas kyi cho gdage legs gter chen/dgo༄/ /rab gnas kyi chesna ga bklags pa'i don grub dge legs kyi gter chen bkra shis rab rgyas bzhugs dren/ /bla ma dang mgon 4 'jam dpal dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de la 'dir sku gsung zugs kyi rten rab tu gnas pa'i tshul bshad pa la/ rab gnas byed dgos midagos kyi khyad pas /rab gnas kyi cho ga dag ma dag gi skyon yon/ rab tu gnas par byed pa'i slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid/ rab tu gnas par byed pa'i gnas dang dus/ rab tu gnas par bya ba'i rten gyi khyad pagrab gnas kyi don dang sgra bshad pa/ rab gnas lha gang gi sgo nas byed pa/ rab gnas kyi tsho ga'i khyad par dang bcu las/ dang po ni/ sbyor sku gsung thugs kyi rten grub tsam nyid nas rab 〉lha ༵ /lha /sna sa/ sna/ pardo gā m+p+raṃ yupa snye ṭ+wāṃ pa rnyi trī/ rdzu tā dz+nyo rlos tshi / ṭ+wāṃ gh+nā bas/ dang] de bzhin du mdo phyogs su sku gsung zugs kyi rten bzhengs pa dang] phyag mchod sogs byas pas phan yon mtha'alpus pa thob par bshad kyi/ rab gnas byadagos par ma gsungs pas/rab gnas ma byas par du rtenadedag la phyag mchod mi 'os pa'idogs pa tsam yang ga ladagos/de lta na yang rgyud sde las/ sbyin bdag gi badrend nams mtha' yas pa spel ba/ rtenade yul gang du gnas pa der bkra shis pa sogs kyi ched du rab gnas gsungs pa ltad dgos pa de dag gi ched du rab gnas dgos lte/ rab gnas kyi rgyud las/ skye bo rab tu dang pa yis/ /brjod 301
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum kapa'i dge ba spel ba'i sgyig /rab gnas bstan bcos las gsungs pa/ /tha snyad tsam du byas pa yin/ /zhes dang / sdom 'byung las kyang] ji ltar rab tu mi gnas lha/ /rab tu gnas par bya bar nus/ /slob ma dad pas gsol 'debs pa'i/ /bsod nams phyir ni bya ba yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar shes byed shin tu mang po /de la mdo sngags mang 4 la ma sbyangs shing / rab gnas rgyud kyi dgongs pa ma lon par de'i tshig zin tsam mthong ba'i 'od kyi sngags rgan mang 4 zhig na re/de ltar rab gnas ma byas kyang sku gsung zugs kyi ltan la phyag sogs 'os na/'o na rab gnas kyi rgyud las/ de srid mchod par de mi 'os/ /dper na skyes bu la la zhig /rig pa'i mtshan nyid spangs pa la/ /'dzig rten kun gyis mchod mi byed/ /don de bzhin du gzugs brnyan la/ /gang gis mchod cing phyag byed pa/ /dam tshig bral zhing sdigs dman pas/ /sbyin sreg thal ba 'bras med mtshungs/ /zhes phyag sogs mi 'os par ma zad phyag sogs byas na dam tshig nyams par gsungs pa ma yin nam/ zhe na/ de ni gtan nas min te/ mchong 'os mi 'os rab gnas gzhug pa'i lha la ltos te/ de tsam mchod mi 'os zhes pa yin gyi/ sgyir mchod pa tsam yang mi 'os zhes pa ni ma yin te/ dkon mchog la skyabs su song nas sku gsung zugs kyi rten gang la yang mthong ba bzhin du gus pa ma byas na skyabs 'gro dang ldan phyin skyabs 'gro dang 'gal bar 'gyur zhing /skyabs 'gro dang mi ldan na nang pa sangs rgyas par mi tshud la/ rgyal sras zhi ba lhas kyang / dam chos dkon mchog thams cad dngan /mchod rten rnams dang sku gzugs la/ /rin chen me tog la sogs chag /rgyun mi 'chad par 'bab par lhastog /ces sku gsung shugs kyi rten mtha' dag la smon lam gyi sgo nas mchod par gsungs pa bzhin/ rgyud sne gong ma'i gso kyong gi skabs su yang de ltar bshad par ma zad bde mchog sogs su rang gi bla ma dang lha'i sku sogs mthong ba na/ rkang brgyad kyi bstod pa dang skor ba sogs yid kyis bya dgos par bshad pa sogs shin tu 302
rab gnas kyi tsho ga dge legs gter chen/mang la/'o na grub chen gyi gzhung las/ sa rdo shing gi rang bzhin gyi/ /sku gzugs dag la phyag mi s+pha /r+shas pa ji ltar snyam na/ de ni spyod pa'i skabs su khams la lus kyi phyag skor sogs bkag pa yin gyi/ yid kyi phyag 'gog pa ga la yin/ dam tshig gi skad dod sa ma ya mnyam pa la 'jug pas lha rab tu gnas pa dang mnyam pa dang bral ba ste/ mtshod yul du rab gnas byas ma byas kyi gzugs brnyan gnyis mchod sogs kyi yul la mi mnyam zhes bstan pa yin gyi/ dam tshig dang bral ba kho nar bshad ga la dgos/ rgyud sdom 'byung las kyang / rnam rtog med pa'i rang bzhin gyis/ rab gnas ltani gzhug pa yin/ /'jig rten skyong ba'i ltal sogs/ /gang tshe rtag tu gnas gyur pa/ /mchod dang mchod bya mnyam ldan papa /de tshe lha yang yang dag gzhug /ces gsungs pas kyang shes la/ dam tshig gi sgra sor gnas byas kyang / rang la lha'i nga rgyal dang gsal snang brtan pa 'ga' zhig la dgongs srid kyi/ skye 4 rang 'ga' ba dag la lha der phyag 'tshal ba tsam gyis dam tshig nyams par mi 'argyur zhing] lade la zhib cha dang bshad bya shin tu mang 4 yod pas legs par dpyad dgos kyi cal col ga la rigs/gnyis pa rab gnas tshad ldan byas pa la phan yon mtha' yas pa 'byung ba ni/ rab gnas kyi rgyud las/ cho ga 'di nyid nus pa yis/ /rtog pa las gsungs tshul legs pas/ /de byas bsod nams che ba ni/ /mthong dang ma mthong 'bras bu skye/ /sku gzugs kyi ni mtshan nyid kyis/ /de la byin rlabs 'jurga par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ de bzhin du yang sngags gnas pas/ /mchod ldan mchod pa byed pa dang] /de yi las kyi rnam smin gyis/ /skye ba ru ni mchod par 'gyug /zhes gsungs pa ltar 7dos/ni sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar du 'bras bu mtha'alpus pa 'byung la/ rab gnas ma byas pa dang cho ga ma legs pa'i nyis pa ni/ rab gnas kyi rgyud las/ gang du sku gzugs rdzogs pa dang / /zhes pa nas/ de srid mtshod par de mi 'os/ /zhes sogs dang /303
