kun mkhyen gsung 'bum kadag tu gsum 'dzid na/ /khyim pa gos dkar ldan pas min/ /zhes gsungs shing] de'i rgyu mtshan yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan spru byung ba dang dar ba'i tha snyad kyang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi cha lugs 'chang ba'i dge 'dun sgya lde byung ba dang dar ba la byed dgos pas/ yul gyi rgyal po la sogs pa bla ma byed pa la/ rgyal ṭo in+d+ra bhu ti/ rgyal po zla bzang lta bu'i sa thob pa ma gtogs khyim pa bla mar byar mi rung bar bshadade/ dus gshor rtsargyud las/ sa 'ob ma gtogs khyim pa ni/ /rgyal 4 bla ma mi bya ste/ /de la zos pa yongs shes pas/ /gang gi rtags can bya ba ni/ /sa thob ma gtogs slobadangonani/ /khyim spru gang tshe mchod byed pa/ /de me+e sangs rgyas chosadangani/ /dge 'dun rnams la gus med 'gyug /zhes gsungs pa dang / gzhan yang tshul khrims ni 〈snan tan thams cad kyi gzhir bshad pa dang / 'dul ba'i lde snod bstan pa dang ston pa gnyis zhar bshad pa sogs kyi phyir na/ sgyin bdag rnams kyis kyang dge 'dun gyi sde dar thabs la 'bad par bya la/ dge 'dun rnams kyis kyangadage 'dun gyi ngang tshul rnam par dag pa 'ong thabs la 'bad par bya ba ni bstan pa'i rtsab 'dzin pa'i thabs bla na med pa'o/ /bzhi pa gnas ni/ dus gshor rtsargyud las/ gang na sa skyong chos ldan zhing / /gang zhig kho na skyedagu rnams/ /bder gnas sa 'dzin rtsod med pa'i/ /gnas der rnal 'phyor brtsams par s+pha /zhes dang / gzhan yang 'dus pa'i skor las kyang / yang thog mchod rten sogs gnas dang] /khyim pa lha yi gnas rnams su/ /sangs rgyas la serdzogs rab gnas ni/ /:sna ga dag dang ldan par sga /zhes dang] sgyi rgyud las kyang] mchod rten chen po nyams dga'adang/ /dpen pa yi ni gnas dag r+ya /ri yi tshemo rgya chen pu /dngos grub dkyil pa'or bri bar sga /zhes gsungs pa ltag rgyud rang rang gi bshad pa'i mtshan nyid ci rigasadang ldan pa'i yid dang mthun pa'i bkra shis pa'i gnas su bya'o/ /306
rab gnas kyi cho gdage legs gter chen/lnga pa dus la/ dus mi rung ba la byas pa'i nyes dmigs ni/ spyi rgyud las/ tshes grangasangan dang dus min dngad /gnas min tsho ga mi ldan pas /mkhas pas dkyil gsor mi bri'o/ /bris na dogs pa med par 'chi/ /zhes dang] rab gnas kyi rgyud las kyang zla ba drug bshadade/ dpyid zla ra ba'am dpyid zla 'bring zhes sogs sgyir gtang dang / dmigs bsal ni dus thams cad du rab gnas rung ba dang/ nus ldan la skyon med tshul ni/ /bi bhu ta'i bde mchog dkyil chog las/ dbyar dus rab gnas grub pa'o/ /ston ni bde ba ster bar 'gyug /dgun stod ye shes 'phel ba lte/ /dgun smadadabang phyug thams cad 'byung/ /dpyid ka dpal ni rab tu sgyin/ /sos ka rgyal dang zhi ba nyes /rab gnas dus ni thams cad pu /sangs rgyas bzhugs su 'jug par bzhed/ /ces dngad gur las kyangaka gtsug tor rtag tu sgyin par s+pha /rtag tu sgyin sreg byed du gzhug /rtag tu dkyil dgor bri bar sga /rtag tu sangs rgyas rab gnas bya/ /zin pa'i de ma thag pa ru/ /rab tu gnas pa ma27ga tu 'gyur/ /zhakhor 'og bsgyur ba'i rgyal 4 yi/ /dbang phyug thob pa the tshom med/ /de la gza' dang rgyu skar med/ /bgegs dang log par 'dren pa'ang med/ /cung zad yid la gang 'dod pa'i/ /skye nas skye bar 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs la/ gzhan yang / rab gnas la bsngags pa'i zla ba drug ste/ rab gnas kyi rgyud las/ dpyid zla ra ba'amadapyid zla r+sāng] /dgun dang dpyid kyi tha chungangam/ /dbyar rade bzhinadabyar 'bring 4/ /nyi ma byang du gnas pa yi/ /zhes gsungs la/ gza' bkra shis pa ni phur bu la serdzogs pa bzhi dang / nyi ma la sogs pa gsum la mi rung bar bshad de/ rgyud las/ phur bu gza' lhag pa pa sangs/ /zhi ba'i gza' rnams zhes bya ba/ /'di rnams las byas gza' ldan te/ /rab tu gnas pa mchog tu shes/ /nyi ma srin pa mig dmar ni/ /nor rnams lajoms pas spang bar s+pha /zhes gsungs/ skar ma'i khyad par la chu stod sogs rung ba bcu gsum/ de las ldog pa ni 307
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum kami rung bar yang bshad de/ rgyud las/ thams cad du ni chu stod dang] /snar ma hro zhun de bzhin ྅ dā/zhi/sna sna pa ༈ /pa t+na k+ṣ+ṇā shā dā spras/ /snaX da/nga shā dzo/ (phe dzo sna shā / slo/ sna/sa /shā /lha /shā pa mchog tu byed/ /skar ma das la rab gnas sga /de ni shes rab chen por 'gyur/ /yid la 'dod pa ci yang rung / /dngos grub me bzhis ster bar 'gyug /lung las shes pa'i yang dag ༵/la/ /( rnyi lham dīr+sha nā ṭ+wāṃ snan shāsab/ra/ pa/ sno/sa /lha /( k+ṣiṃ pasbyo /la/ lha( dgarta lhapa snro dngos grub khums smad kyis/ /rgyal gyis rtag par tshe ring 'gyur/ /snron gyis mchog tu bde bar byed/ /lha mtshams kyis ni mchog ster 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ tshes grangs yang gtso por yar ngo la bya la/ mar ngo la'ang rung bar bshad de/ rgyud las/ dkyil 'khor dang ni rab gnas pa/ /yar gyi ngo la rtag par bya/ /gza' dang skar ma 'dzom gyur na/ /mar gyi ngo la'ang nyes pa med/ /ces gsungs pas de ltar s+phadrug pa rab tu gnas bya'i rten ni/ mchog sku gsung thugs kyi rten dang/ dge 'dun gyi kun dga' rwa ba rdo rje dril bu bgrang phreng rgyan drug sogs so/ /phal ba ni khang pa khang bzang skyed tshal khron pa chu mig sogs yin la/ de re re la'ang sgyi 'gro'i rab gnas dang / rang rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i rab gnas byed tshul gnyis gnyis rung zhing/ sbyo 'gro'i rab gnas byed pa la yangakathog mar rab tu gnas bya la du ma yod pas/ gtso 4 sku gsung thugs kyi rten la'ang de dag sgrub tshul dang] chags tshad dang ring bsrel gyi snying ṭo can la thenags par mkhas pa dag gi chags tshad kyi yi ge dag dngaka gzungs 'jug gi rnam bzhag gsal bar ston pa 'khrul slong nyin mor byed pa la sogs pa'i bshad pa ltar dgos te/ rab gnas kyi rgyud las/ sku gzugs mtshan 308
rab gnas kyi cho gdage legs gter chen/nyid ldan pa lte/ /zhi ba la sogs ro yi ldan/ /tshad kyi tshad la phab cing bzang / /de 'drar rab tu gnas par 'gyud /zhes gsungs/ /sdom 'byung las kyang / blug ma'am mngon par 'du byas pa'i/ /sku gzugs la sogs pa rnams ni/ /rab gnas don gu zhes dngaka sku gzugs sam ni glegs bam mam/ /bris sku yongs su rdzogs pa rnams/ /mdun rol tu ni bzhag par sga /zhes gsungs pa ltar zhi ba la sogs pa'i ro lte lha rang rang gi zhi drag gang yin gyi nyams thon zhing chags tshad la phebs te tshad dang ldan ba dgos/bdun pa rab gnas kyi don ni/ don dam par rab tu gnas bya gnas byed sogs chos thams cad bden par ma grub pa nam mkha' lta bu zhig yin kyang / tha snyad du rdzas sngags ting nge 'dzin sogs rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba rnams tshogs pa dang / rgyal ba rang nyid kyi gsung ltar thugs dam bskul ba la brten nas/ ye shes pa'i tshogs gdul bya'i mos ngo dang bstun par dam tshig pa la rab tu gnas pa'am/ rab tu gzhug pa gcig la byed pa yin te/ rab gnas kyi rgyud las/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis gsol ba/ bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad rab tu gnas pa la ji ltar rgyal ba rnams kyis gnas pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sangs rgyas kun gyis rab tu gzhug/rab tu gnas pa gang yang med/ /kun tu mkha' ltar gnas pa la/ /cig shos kyis ni rab tu brtag /'jig rten kun rdzob la brten nas/ /rab tu gnas pa rab tu brtag /dam pa'i don du dbyad pas na/ /gang zhig gang gis gang du brlabs/ /gzod ma nas zhi skye med pas/ /ci 'dras ji ltar rab tu gnas/ /dang po'i las can sems can rnams/ /rtog pa'i rgyu ru bshad par zad/ /ces dang / sdom 'byung las kyang /ji ltar rab tu mi gnas lha rab tu gnas par bya bar nus/ /slob ma dad pas gsol 'dobs pas/ /brtsod nams phyir ni bya ba ste/ /rnam rtog med pa'i rang bzhin gyis/ /rab nas lha ni 309
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum kagzhug pa yin/ /'jig rten skyong ba'i lha la sogs/ /gang tshe rtag tu gnas gyur pa/ /mchod dang mchod bya mnyam ldan pad /de me+e lha yang yang dag gzhug /ces dang/ mdo las kyang/ gang gi mos pa gtsor byed pa/ /de yi mdun na chub pa bzhugs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltag dmigs rnams dwangs la shin tu gsal ba gcig rab gnas kyi gtso 'o la dgos shing / de ltar ma byung rna dad mos shugs drag cig yan chad rab gnas byed pa la shin tu dgos par go/brgyad pa sgra bshad ni/ rab gnas kyi skad dod su blo ti ṣ+ṭha'i su legs pa/ blo ñtsā rab tu'am so sesnar ṣ+ṭha/ gnas pa ste legs par rab tu gnas pas na rab gnas zhes bya ste/ lha ye shes pa dam tshig pa la rab tu gnas byed ces pa'i don yin pa'i phyig yang legs par so sor gnas par byed pas na rab tu gnas zhes bya ste/ lha ye shes pa serdzo so dam tshig pa 〈sna sesna la gnas par byed pa'am/ lhayi shes pa'i sku sogs kyi cha dam tshog pa'i so so la gnas par byed pas na rab gnas zhes brjod pa'i phyig yanganges tshig gis bshadanadangos 4 phal ba ye shes semasadapa'i dngos po grub lte gnas par byed pas na rab gnas zhes bya ste/ bra ka rā ṇa na ti ṣ+ṭha mchog tu gnas par byed pas na rab gnas su ci ltar pra ti ṣ+ṭha shin tu yun ring du gnas par byed pas na rab gnas zhes 'jug pa'i phyigdgu pa ltagang gi sgonas rab tu gnas pani/ 'dzigs byed gsang bde gsum ltabu'idakyil gshor yod pas lhade dang de'i dkyil lha'or bskyedanas bya ba'am/ yang na slob dasan rang gi lhag pa'i lha gang yin pader bskyedanas byed pa'am/ yang na sku'i rten sku rdo rje'i rigs gsung gi rten gsung rdo rje'i rigs/ zugs kyi rten thugs rdo rjer bskyed pa/ de lta bu'i rigs kyi dbye ba mthong pas shes par bya la/ de bzhin du dngos 4 gnas khang bzang sogs kyang rigs so so ba bskyed pa'am/ rigs drug pa lta bu'i rigs gcig bar bskyed na'ang rung lte/ rab gnas kyi rgyud las/310
rab gnas kyi tsho gdage legs gter chen/sku gang rab tu gnas bya ba/ /de lades dkyil lubor sga /yangan rang gi lhag pa'i nya slobadangon rang gi gangasan pa/ de nidabye ba mthong bas sga zhes gsungs so/ /bcapa cho ga lade gzhung gang la brten pa ni/ dus dngor gyi rab gnas kyi rgyud/ rmya rdo rje/ sdom 'byung/rdor 'tsheng] de'i 'grel pa rnamasadangaka dus zhabs che chung dang/ sā du pu tras mdzad pa'i dus 'khor gyi rab gnas/ nag 4 bas mdzad pa'i gsang 'dus dang kyai rdor rab gnas/ n+ma 'jigs pa'i phyag/snang mdzad zla ba/zla 'od rnams kyis mdzad pa'i gsang 'dus kyi rab gnas/ rin chen 'bar ba/ ngagadabang grags pa/ su ma ti gnyis mdzad pa'i rab gnas/ slob dpon kun snying dang bra dzha wa li tis mdzad pa'i rnal 'gyor rgyud kyi rab gnas/ slobadapon zhi ba snying pos mdzad pa'i mchod rten bsgrub pa'i cho ga /dkyil tshog rdor phreng/ sku khus kyi cho ga /rab gnas kyi rgyal 4 rnams serdzo/ /dedag rnams ci ñdzaṃrdo ༷ ༷༷ ṭ+wāṃ tram̐ sta/ shaṃ/ a+thi+-i ༈ smaṃ ༷ ༷༷ two ṭ+wāṃ ṭī ༵ shī ༷ khri pa/pa dang po rgyas pa la/ 〈snan 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ mjug gi rim m+pa gsum las/ dang po la/ sdom las/ legs bshams bdag bskyed bum pa bzlas/ /rten spyangs bkru zhing pyi ba dang / /rten bskyed ye shes spyan drangs la/ /bgegs bskrad mchod pa dgug gzhug bya/ /rgyas btab mchod bstod gtor ma btang / /snyan gsan dbab cing mchod bstod s+pha /bzod par gsol zhing gshegs su ga〈snal/ /rten dbab bdag bsrung lta gon s+pha /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rten legs par bshams pa dang / bdag bskyed bum pa lta gon dang / rten sbyangs pa/ bkru zhing dbyi ba/ lten bskyed pa/ ye shes pa spyan drangs shing gzhug pa/ rgyas gdab pa dang / mchod cing bstod de gtor ma btang ba dang / snyan gsan dbab la mchod pa dang / bzod par gsol te 311
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum kagshegs pa dang / rten dbab pa dang / bdag gi gnas gsum bsrung ba nye don bcu gsum po 'di/ rab gnas kyi lta gon dang / rab gnas kyi lha lhag gnas zhes bya ste/ rgyud sdom 'byung las/ blugs ma'am mngon par 'du byas pa'i/ /sku gzugs la sogs pa rnams ni/ /rab gnas don du sa sbyangs shing / /bla bre rgyal mtshan ba dan rnams/ /brgyan cing sa ni yongs su bzung / /sku gzugs sam ni glegs bam mam/ /bris sku yongs su rdzogs pa rnams/ /mdun rol tu ni bzhag par s+pha /dkyil dngor gangor lo rnam par gnas/ /nyer spyod lnga yis yang dag mchod/ /sa ma ya s+t+waṃ sa ma ya ho/ /lan gsum du ni brjod par sga /ji ltar rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun/ /dga' ldan yang dag bzhugs nas ni/ /lha mo sgyu 'phrul lhums 'jug ltar/ /de bzhin 'dir ni gshegs su gsol/ /che ge zhes bya'i don du ni/ /byang chub sems ni yongs 'phel gyis /me tog la sogs 'di bzhes te/ /mdon 4 'dir ni rtag bzhugs mdzod/ /tshig 'dis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams/ /lhag par gnas par byas na ni/ /mkhas pa yis ni bstod byas nas/ /yungs dkar gyi ni bskor nas su/ /lan gsum du ni sbyang bar s+pha /zhes gsungs/ grub chen dpal 'dzin gyi dgra nag gi dkyil chog las kyang / de nas rab gnas kyi sa gzhi ni gdugs sna tshogs pa dang / zhes pa nas/ gti mug rdo rje'i ngo 'o zhes bya ba la sogs pas bstod par bya'o/ /zhes bya ba ni lha lhag par gnas pa'o/ /zhes sogs kyi sta gon tshang bar bshad pa'i phyidgnyis pa dngos gzhi la sdom ni/ tho rangs bdag bskyed mdun bskyed mchod/ /rten sbyangs bkru zhing dbyi ba dngad /ring bsrel gzhug cing gsol ba gdab/ /rten bskyed spyan drangs dgug rgyas gdab/ /dbang bskur mchod bstod spyan dbye sga /gsol gdab mnga' dbul rgyas par byed/ /yang na mchod bstod bye brag dang / /sbyin sreg sngags de dngos gzhi'o/ /zhes gsungs 312
rab gnas kyi cho ga dge legs gter chen/snang/ dīsna /tshi bskrushān pasbya/ paX spri sdi traṃ dpad+me r+shaspriji rnyi/ hūm̐ sdisra basbyoX m+p+raṃ ((1 lha sna/lha dgos na gzhugs pa dang / lha la gsol ba gdab pa dang / rab tu gnas bya'i lha bskyed pa dang /ye shes pa dang dbang lha spyan drangs te dgug gzhug bya ba dang / bya rgyud ltar na chu cod pan gyi dbang bskur ba dang / rnal 'byor rgyud ltar na rigs lnga'i dbang lnga slob dbon gyi dbang sogs dang bcas pa dang / rnal 'byor bla med ltar na dbang bzhi rka'ang skabs lanar slob ma la bskur ba ltar yang rung bas/ dbang bskur te rigs bdag gis rgyas btab pa dang / rab gnas kyi lha la mchod pa dang / bstod pa dang spyan dbye ba dang / brtan par bzhugs su gsol ba dang /mnga' dbu la rgyas par bya ba/ sbyin sreg dang rab gnas kyi brtan bzhugs dang / shis pa brjod pa/ gtang rag gi mchod bstod bya ba nye khyad par bcu bdun tshang dgos te/ sdom 'byung las/dri zhim ldan pa'i mar gyis byugs/ /'dag chal gyis ni khras kyang s+pha /slar yang bum pa sem dreg yis/ /sku gzugs rnams ni khrus kyang bya/ /phyi nas nam mkhar gnas pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor 'o bcom ldan 'das/ /blugs ma la serdzogs rab gzhug bya/ /yul chesnas la glegags ji bzhin du/ /las bcu yi ni bya ba byas/ /spyan ni dbye ba byas nas su/ /rdo rje'i spyan ni byin gyis brlabs/ /de bzhin me tog spos mar me/ /byug pa zhal zas de bzhin te/ /de ltar las ni kun bya'i pyir/ /sbyin sreg las kyi rje gas par byas/ /lha kun zhal ni me yin pas/ /mkhas pas rab tu gnas par bya/ /rab gnas yang dag rdzogs dus su/ /bstod dang bkra shas brjod bya zhing / /mṛ dang ga 〈snags sil snyan dang / /ji ltar mnyes pas rab tu malngasnad/ /ces gsungs/dpal 'dzin gyi dgra nag gi dkyil chog las kyang/ tho rangs kyi dus su sku gzugs gos ser pos g.yo gas la shar du bstan te khras bya'o/ /zhes pa ni rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga'o/ /zhes pa'i 313
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum kabar dang mthun no/ /gsum pa mjug gi tsho ga ni/ sdom las/ gtor ma sgyin dang chos skyong bsgo/ /dkyil 'khor mchod cing dngos grub blangs/ /bzod par gsol te gshegs su gsol/ /yon bdag bsgo zhing shis pa brjod/ /rten mchod bsod nams yongs su basprad /slob /(sna mamis//dri sprapa lhasna/ shārnyi( shā rnyi gh+nā rdzus ༵༵ 〉ba/ /〉pa ba/(spra tsho k+ṣiṃ /shā mchod cing gsol ba gdab pa/ bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol/ yon bdag bsgo ba/ bkra shis par byed pa/ rten la mchod pa/ bsod nams bgro ba/ slob dpon la mchod pa/ dge 'dun dang snrosna /sna rnyi sbyosbyo pa/ hādī zla (lha ( zlo( spra lha/༵ dī tram̐ rjesna paspri r+sha/sna dzo snagazlo (( 'byung las/ ston mo dang ni yon 'bul bas/ /skye 4 tshim zhing dgyes par sga /dgyes pa'i skye rgyo skal ba bzangaka /bkra shis zhi bar bcas gyur te/ /zhes gsungs/ nag 4 ba'i dkyil chog las kyang] gal te 'gyor bar gyuran de rnams kyi mthe 'ong g.yas pa lag pa g.yon pas bzung ste zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya ste/ dgang zlugs dang bsreg blugs lan gcig gam lan gsum mam/ bdun phul nas yon blang bar bya'o/ /des kyang dga' ba'i yid kyis ji ltar 'gyor pa'i sa gzhi dang /glang 4 dang / rta dngad gser dang] rgyan dang / bu dang] chung ma la sogs pa 'bul zhing/ bdag nyid thos pa la sogs yon tan bsngags/ dngos grub kyis bh+yor 'bangs su dbul bar bya'o/ /de ltar slobada'on la rab tudaga' ba'isku'on phulanas/ kha zas dang gyod pa kun gyis rangadang gnas kyi 'khor lo mchod par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang) lung de rnams rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum ga'i shes byed du 'gro'o/ gnyis pa 'bring ṭo la/ sdom 'byung las bshad pa ltar sa skyangs gzungs rnams sngon du btang nas/ de rjes dgra nag gi dkyil tshog las gsungs pa ltar byed 314
rab gnas kyi cho gdage legs gter chen/dgos pas/ de la sdon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ mnga'adabul sogs kyi rim pa gsum las/ dang po la thog mar bya ba'i rim pa/ sbyangs pa'i rim pa/ khus kyi rim pa gsum las/ dang po la/ sdom ni/ bdag bskyed bum pa lhag gnas sga /khus stegs rgyan bri mnga' dbul bri/ /gsemal gdab sems skyed rten bskyed cing] /gdan la rten bzhag chu gzhi 'bul/ /zhes pa'i rim pa ltar 'og mar gsang bde 'jigs gsum sogs dkyil gabor gang la brten pa'i bdag bskyed lha bum khus bum lhag gnas bya dgos shing] de la yang thog mar gnas brgyan cing rten bshams pa'i tshul ni/ dgra nag gidakyil tshog las/ des na rab gnas kyi sa gzhi ni/ gdugs sna tshogs pa dang] rgyal mtshan dngad ba dan sna tshogs pa dang / rol mo'i sgra sna tshogs pa la sogs pas yid du 'ong bar byas la/ slob dngon ji ltar 'byor pa'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyananas/ sku gzugs sam/ ras bris sam/ glegs bam mdun du bzhag ste/ zhes gsungs pa ltag sa rgyan gnam rgyan yol ba sogs mjes par bshams/ dkyil gangor sgrub pa dang 'brel na lha gang yin gyi dkyil gshor mchod rdzas sogs rang rang gi gzhung ltar bshams/de nas khus stegasadang mnga'adabul sogs 'god pa la/ khras stegs ni/ dkyil 'khor gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa'i phyi nas rim pa bzhin dkar dmar nag pa'i rtsig pa rim pa gsum pa/ 'phar ma gnyis dang ldan pa/ de'i dbus su pad+ma ladab brgyad kyi lte ba la shar du gangor lo/ lhor rin chen/ nub tu pad+ma/ byang du ral sgras mtshan pa brtsigs pa'am rdul tshon gyis bris pa'am/ chu tshon gyis bris pa'i ras bris sam/ ma 'byor na bsgom pa tsam gyis kyang rung ngo] /de'i lteng du shing stan la zla ba'idakyil lha'or bris pa'i ras sna gh+nā pa༈ pa/ ṭ+wāṃ dī /dris tsa/༈ lha ༵ tā n+dha ༵ ji sprihā pyad zlo/ ༷da sdi rnyipa ṭ+wāṃ kāpa ༵ rī de] pa/ legs par bkrus/ kha rgyan dang mgul chings dang ldan pa dkyil chog ltar byas la gu gul gyi 315
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum kadud pas bdug/khro bo'i sngags bzlas pa'i yungs dar gyis brab/ rta 'ong sogs kyis ma bzod pa'i chu gtsang mas sum gnyis bkang/ lha'i bum par sman lnga/ rin po che lnga/dri lnga/ 'bru lnga/ snying po lnga ste bum rdzas nyer lnga gzhug/khus bum dri ma zhabrud pa brgyad dri sna tshogasadang] mngar gsum dang / zho dngaka ga ka ru dang] kham ltar sogs 'bru sna tshogs dang / 'bras yos dang / sman sna tshogs dang / rin 4 che sna tshogs pa rnams bum pa brgyad du blug par bya'o/ khus bum gcig las med na rdzasade brgyad ka gcig tu blug par bya zhing] khus bum la bum mtshan mi dgos/ lha bum la bum mtshan dkyil chog ltar bya/ khyas bum rnams khras dkyil gyi 'dab ma brgyad la 'god/ mnga' dbul la gling bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa thig gdab/ phyogs kyi tshangs thig rnams cha gnyis su btang] chanang ma deni cha re re la'ang cha lnga lnga lte phyogs gnyis/ cha sdom nas tshangs rig bcu par s+pha dbus kyi cha gnyis pad+ma ma lhag ma'i phyogs re re'i cha la tshangs thig gi steng nas zur thig cung zad thal zhing phyogs gzhan gyidangos thig la reg pa'i thig drang po bzhi btab ste/ phyogs bzhi byang chub chen po'i mchod rten gyi bang rim ltar je chung je chung byas pa/ mtshams de'i zur thig gi dkyil nas bcad pa'i gru bzhi pa bzhi byed/ dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa phyi rol gyi zur kun tu pad+mas bskor ba la/ phyogs bzhir ri'i rgyal po ri rab bang rim bzhi'i shar dkag lho sngo / nub dmad byang ser pho/ zur bzhi na sngon po gru bzhi'i phreng ba/ ri rab de'i phyi rol lcags ri'i nang gi bar du mtsho ris byas pa la mtsho'i dbus nas thon pa lta bu'i gling bzhi gling phran brgyad/ shar du gling gsum zla gam/ lhor gling gsum sog kha/ nub tu gling gsum zlum 4/ byang du gling gsum gru bzhi/ des na shar du dpal ze'u dang gshor lo/ lhor pad+ma dang rgyal mtshan/ nub tu gdugs dang bum ba/ byang du dung dang nya bris/ de'i mtha' skor du mnga' dbul gyi mchod pa rnams bshams/ gzhan yang rang gis dam gyi lha'i gtor mdangam chos skyong 316
rab gnas kyi cho gdage legs gter chen/gtor ma 'byung sho thams cad pa'i gtor ma dang / gzhi bdag gtor ma rnams bshams la rdor dril dang dung rnga rol mo la sogs pa'i sgradang bcas pas byinadabab/ bdag bskyed bzlas gtor k+ṣiṃ pazlo pa/ shām+bhi dī ṭā/ smra/ ṭ+wāṃ swāhā pā rdzu (sdi /( 1 k+ṣiṃ ba/ sbyipa ༷shā/ hūm̐ smrapa pa pa~X ༵༵ pa/ la sogs pa mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan pa'i nang du bcud sna tshogs pas bkang bar bsam la/ zho'i bum pa la da dhi sna na pū dza me gha sa mu dra sga ra na sa ma ya shri ye hūṃ/ zhes gsungs/ de bzhin du sngags kyi 4ga mtha' gnyis 'dra la 'bras bu sna tshogs kyi bum pa la pha la sna na dang /'bru sna tshogs kyi bum pa bru hi sna na dang / 'bras skyusnas kyi bum pa la lari sna na dang / sman sna tshogs kyi bum pa la mo ṣa nyi sna na dang / dri'i bum pa la gharnye sna na dang / mngar gsum gyi bum pa la tri ma du sna na dang / rin chen sna tshogs kyi bum pa la ma ṇi sna na la thog mtha' btags pa brjod la byin gyis brlabs/ 'dir khras kyi bum pa la lha bskyed mi dgos/ rab gnas rgyas /kaus+dza pasna rjod kā k+to snang /sna sngu )phru rdo/ spradel zlo rlo ṭ+wāṃ dhi sna ṭ+wāṃ gh+nā ༷dī /spripa blangs nas bsgrub na legs/ de nas ga〈snal ba gdab pa ni/ so so'i lag tu me tog thogs te/yon tan dran pa'i sgo nas/ gang 'dir bcom ldan 'das zhes pa nas/ 'gro ba ma lus pa'i rtsalag tu gyur pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di bdag gis rab tu gnas par bgyi'o/ /zhes so so'i mjug tu rab tu gnas bya'i rten la me tog 'jur/ spos kyi bdug rol metsha 'bul zhing / 46 na snang lha ga wa te/ shākya mu na ye/ ta thā ga ta ya/ arta te samyaka saṃ bud+dha ya/tabya thā/ oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hwa mu ni ye swāhā/ zhes gsungs/ rab tu gnas bya'i lha sgrol ma lta bu yin na/ oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re swāhā/ zhes pa ltabu lha so so rang rang gis ngo shes pa'i sngags yod 317
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum kapa de dang] oṃ badz+ra sa twa hūṃ zhes pa rang gi yi dam gyi lha'i sngags kyang brjod do/ /sems bskyed pa ni/ sems can thams cad la byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgom la/ ngag nas kyang 'do skad ces brjod par bya lte/ ngo mtshar chen 4 grangs med cing / bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa'i zhes pa nas/ dngos grub kyi mchog stsol zhing gnang ba mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod cing me tog 'jur/ rten bskyed pa ni/ las bum gyi chus rten la gtor la/ bighān takrita dam hrīḥlha 'am badz+ra yak+ṣa lta bu'i rang rang gi las sngags kyis bsangs/ swa bha wa'am shun+ya tas stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gsung rab kyi po ti rnams pad nyi'i steng du 〉ཿlas pad+ma hrīḥs mtshan pa las 'odadapag med dmar 4 pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa la rang 'dra'i yum gos dkar mos gabyud padang/ mchod rten dang gtsug lag khang dang khang bzang sogs la pad zla'i steng du hūṃ las gdor lo bhu gyis mtshan pa las rnam snang dkar 4 zhakhor lo dang dril bu 'odzin pa la rang 'dra'i yum spyan mas zhabyud par bskyed pa'am/ yang nadakyil lugar gang la brten pa'i skabasadang sbyar ba'i gsung dang sku rdo rjer bskyed kyang rung1 sku gzugs rnams rab tu gnas bya'i lha de dang der bskyed pa'am/ yang na thams cad la rdo rje 'chang dkyil gsar rang rang gi gtso sor bskyed pa sogs ji ltar 'dod pa bya la/de yang gtso 'or 'dzigs byed kyi gonas yinan stong pa'irang las rab tu gnas bya'i rten rnams hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa las dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po sku mdog mthing nag zhal dgu zhes pa nas/ g.yon pas yab la 'khyud pa re rer gyug zhes brjod la rten bskyed/ de nas gdan la rten bzhag /chu bzhi dbul ba ni/ rab tu gnas bya'i rten rnams khusadakyil gyi steng du dngos su bzhag pa'am/ bzhag par mos la tshigs bcadadam/ yang na/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta smyo pu dza me gha sa mu tra sga ra ṇa sa ma ya shri yi hūṃ/ zhes pa'i sngags tsam phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod yon/ de bzhin du smolha gyi gnas su pā sh+ya dang / añtsa ma ṇaṃ prok+ṣa 318
rab gnas kyi tsho gdage legs gter chen/ṇaṃ dang sbyar la/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ bsang gtor rnams 'bul lo/ /gnyis pa sbyangs pa ni/ sdomani/ gtor ma yungs chu kham phor lci/ /zan chang ras kyis byabs nas ni/ /nye reg mtshod bdug sbyangs pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltad sbyangs pa la bgegs sbyangs pa/ sdig pa sbyangs pa gnyis/ dang 4 la/ thog mar kho 'o spyan drangs pa ni/ hūṃ ye shes bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od/ /nas/ gshegs su gartsol/ rang gi zugs spu'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros kho bo'i tshogs thams cad badz+ra sa ma dzas spyan drangs mdun gyinam mkhar bzhugs par gyug de nas/ oṃ badz+ra ma hwa kro lharā dzā sa pa ri wā ra a nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod la/ bla med kyi skabs su nang mchod 'bul/ hūṃ chos nyid/ nas/ bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces pa'i bar gyis bstod la/ gtor ma bsang sbyangs/ skye mched byin gyis brlab pa'ag(spra spya/rlaX ༵/sdi( lha /sna k+ṣiṃ g+ne pyā t+na rtswa spya ṭ+wā hūm̐ hūm̐ spya/ /lhanaXn spya hūm̐ paraX lha g+ni par rtsom pa'i bgegs rnams bkug par rgyud sarba n+dagan na maXsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi sho mu khe bh+yaḥsarba data khaṃ khud ga ti s+pha ra na hi me ga ga na khaṃ lha ha na lta ba liṃ ta ye swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis bgros la rngan pa byin te bgegs bskrad pa ni zhi ba'i spyangs pa'o/ /ting lo chang bu dang bcas pa rten la pyir bskor zhing / sngags sum+bha ni bzlas la phyir dor te bgegs bskrad dang bcas pa ni zhi drag phyed ma'i sbyangs pa lte/ rdzas zhi ba dang sngags drag po yin pas then/ /de nas sangs rgyas kyi bden padang] zhes pa nas/ bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten rab tu gnas par byed pa la bar du gcod par rtsom pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs gang yin spru de dag thams cad mchod sgyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen 4 gdos tshom par gyis la/ zhi ba'i semasadang ldan pas rang rang gi gnas su thenang zhig/gal te mi las na khro 4 ye shes 319
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum kakyi rdo rje me rab tu 'bar nas mgo 4 rnam pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ro/ /sum+bha ni dang gyiḥṣ+ṭiḥsogs drag tu brjod la khu gul gyis bdug /yungs dkar gyis brab/ tshams rngam dang rol mo'i sgrodrag tu byas nye/ gtor ma byin kyang 'gro bar mi 'dod pa'i bgegs rnams nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i khro 'o dang rnal 'phyor ba las spros pa'i k+ṣiṃ 'o rnams kyis tshar bcad par bsam pa rje/ drag po'i spyangs pa ste/ rdzas sngags ting nge 'odzin gsum ga drag 4 yin pas so/ /gsum pa sdig pa sbyangs pa la/ yungs kur dang chu dang kham phor dkar po dang / dur ba'i myu gu dang bcas pa'i ba smi'i chang bu dang / zan gang dang sed ras de rnams la hūṃ lan bdun bzlas la/ 'og mar yungs nar lag pa g.yas g.yon gyi khu tshur gnyis kyis rten la g.yon du bskor zhing / oṃ sarba pā baṃ da ha na badz+ra ye badz+ra sa twamya sarba bā tra da ha swāhā/ zhes brjod cing me nang du dog de bzhin du lag pa gnyis kyis yungs lngar yang blangs te/ g.yas su lan gnyis bskor te mer dod de bzhin du chu nas seng ras kyi bar rnams khu tshur gnyis kyis g.yon du bskor nas byabs te 'dor ba dang / de rjes yang khu tshur gyis de dag gnyis pa rnams blangs te/ g.yas su lan gnyis bskor bas byabs te dor ro/ 'on kyang kham phor man chad mer mi dor zhing / kham phor nas seng ras kyi bar bzhi bzhi tshang bar bya la/ de dag gi dang 4 gnyis rnams ni g.yon bskor gnyis byas nas dor ba lta bu yin gyis de dag snga pyi gnyis gnyis kyis g.yon bskor gnyis gnyis dang g.yas bskor gnyis gnyis gnyis ka la byed/ byabs pa yang yul gang yin pa la byabs pa'i rnam par dgos kyi/ rang gi lag nas zan chang dor ba ltar ni mi bya/ dkyil chog rdo rje phreng ba las 'do ltar bskor bar bshad la/ sdom 'byung las kyang/ yungs dar gyis ni bskor nas su/ /lan gsum du ni sbyang bar sga /zhesadang] dpal 'edzin gyi dgra nagadakyil tshog las/ g.yon pa dang g.yas pa'i khu tshuradag tu yungs spur bzung la/ sku gzugs la sogs pa'i 320
rab gnas kyi tsho ga dge legs gter chen/mdun du g.yon pa dang g.yas pas bskor zhing me'i nang du blugs te/ oṃ sarba pā baṃ da ha na badz+ra ya badz+ra sa twa su sarba pā paṃ da ha swāhā/ zhes pa'i sngags 'dis btab pa'i kham phor lan gsum gyi bar du bskor la bskur bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar lan gsum bskor na'ang rung bar mngon no/ /spyang ba'i don yang sdig pa dang smyur dang mi gtsang ba sbyang bar legad pa'i tshul gsum bshad pa'i skabs thob shes dgos par mngon/ de nas lag pa g.yon chu gtsang bzung / g.yas pa'i gung mo dang srin lag gis chu blangs te/rten sku gzugs rnams kyi kha rna ba mig sna lag lte ba mgo 'o rnams su dngos su reg pa'am/ me long la gzugs rnyan shar ba de la de ltar bya la/ rten glegs bam zungags sku gzugs ma yin pa dag la rten de ltar gsal ba'i gnas de dag tu reg par bsam la rten nam me long la reg/de nas sgyuḥ〉ཿ'am/ badz+radrika lta bu dkyil lubor gyi gtso bo'i sngags brjod cing rten rnams kyi thugs spur dri/ dbu la me rtog/mdun du mchodaphungan 'bul/mar me bskor bzhin pag yo badz+ra asmra ta kunali ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa dang/ rgyu lan bdun bzlas pa'i mar dang bcas pa'i spos dkar gyis bdug par bya'o/ /sbyang ba'i don bshad zinato/ /gsum pa khrus kyi rim pa la sdom ni/ snyan gsan bdud rtsib byung chu/ /shing shun 'bru mang skyu ru ga /yungs pa dri lnga'i pye ma rnams/ /dur sngon mir gyis byugs nas su/ /lha rnams spyan drangs bkra shis glu/ /sngon byas lha yi bum pa'i chus/ /bkru dbyi dri dang bordzos rgyan khus/ /zhes pa ltar las/ spros pa la dga' na/ khrus bum lag tu thogs te/ thams cad 'greng lte bya ba'am 'dug kyang rung ste mgrin gcig tu/ bcom ldan 'das nas/ khus 'di gasdurdzol bar bgyi'o/ /zhes pa/sabaspri r+nghi ༈ sna shā sprinaspya snan r+shadībapa/ g+ni ṭ+wāṃ dar+shasna /shā kāpasasna ṅgi/〉dzo dri pa~X dzasna ༵ pa'i bar brjod la/ tshig rkang bzhi pa la bum pa g.yo ba dang / rol mo byed pa'i phyag len bla ma 321
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum kahādī gh+nā ༵ tsho ṭ+wāṃ sdu ram̐ (3 sna/ dā/ stede r+yaṃ sbyishā k+ṣiṃ ༷pa gh+nā sdi dz+nyo ma ༷rnyi ba k+ṣiṃ lte/ spra /pa lngadang] n+ya gro ta/ khu rtu wā da pā la sha 'i n+da li/ lhanamu tra ste/ 'o ma can gyi shing lnga zhes bshad kyang / ma rnyed na 'o ma can gyi shing ji ltar rigs pa'i phye ma dang tsanadan dkar dmag a ka ru/gur gum/ gran thi ka lte lnga'am/ gur gum/ a ka ru/ gla ri ga bug tsan dan lte dri lnga'i phye ma rnams mkhar pa'i sdod du sbyar ba la las thams cad pa dang] hūṃ lan bdun bzla bar yang bshad/khrus byed tshul phyag len mi 'dra ba 'dug yang] dpal 'dzin gyi dkyil chog las/ tho rangs kyi ②lha ṭ+wāṃ smu shārnyi shārnyi ṭ+wāṃ ༵ ༷pa gh+nā dz+nyo rnyipa shā) /rdzu spra ③ pa shārnyisna ༵/ spya rdzu /shā ༵ / /spya par bya'o/ /de nas oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kāya bi zug lha na ye sā hā/ zhes bya bas mar khu dri zhim po la mngon par bsngags la dur ba'i chun pos byugs par bya'o/ /denas shun pa lnga mkhar ba'i snod du bzhag mar khu phyi bar bya'o/ /de'i rjes la rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa so so'i chus sku khus gadre la bar bya ste/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis kyang] /de bzhin gshegs kun khus gathegal ltag /lha yi chu 'di dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khus gathengal/ gu sarba ta thā ga ta a lha ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shī ye hūṃ/ zhes bya bas sngags kyis sesna/ /de'i rjes la nam mkha' la bzhugs pa'i tsartsika la sogs pa'i rig pa'i tshogs rnams spyan drangasanas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chus bkang pa'i bum pa bsnams pas dbang bskur bar bsam la/ de nas ras kyis rlan med par phyis la sngar gyi rang rang gi gnas su bzhag par bya'o/ /ras bris sam glegs bam mam/ mchod rten rnams la ni me long la sngar gyi rim pas khus gsol bar bya'o/ /zhes bya ba ni khrus kyi rim pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltag dri zhim dang ldan pa'i mar gyis byugs la/ 'dag chal la sdugags pa'i phal 322
rab gnas kyi rkyo gdage legs gter chen/khras dang / de'i rjes lha bum gyi khus dgos te/ rgyud sdom 'byung las/dri dang ldan pa'i mar gyis byugs/ /'dag chal gyisani khus kyang s+pha /slar yang bum pa dreg 〈sna yis/ /sku gzugs rnams ni khus kyang byas/ /zhes pas kyang sgra snga mas 'dag rdzas kyis smyug darbastos par ma zad/ 'dag chal gyis phal khus kyang bstan/ phyi ma'i slarayang gi sgras phal khrus su ma zad ltabum 〈sna sesnas slarayang khusadagos par bstan/ kyang sbra sgyi mas khrus gnyis kyi tshe dpyidagos par yang bltan/de la lag tu blangs pa'i rim pa ni/ sku gzugs sogasadangos su bkrudapyi 'os pa rnams ladangos su bya la/dngos su bkrudabyi mi 'os pa'i ras bris glegs bam la sogs pa rnamasa'i me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba la baspudabyi byadagos la/deyang thog mag yo hūṃ sāṃ gyi āḥzhes brjod la dur ba'i pir gyis pa'i rnam lnga byugs/ shā sarbata thā ga ta kā ya bi goraha na ye swāhā/ zhes brjod la dur ba'i chun pos dri zhim dang ldan pa'i mar byugs/ 'o ma can gyi shing shun gyi phye mas mar dbyi/ de nas sbyo ṭ+wāṃ /lhashā sna ( shā/ dwo so zlo shāspya two dz+nyo /rgyu/ shā shā /rdzu laX lham zlotsho sdushāka/hūm̐ r+nghi /pa la dri zhim gyi chus mnangag ltarazung hūṃ ṭ+wāṃ 〉ཿā bris/de lnga brjod cing dri'i rig le lnga byas pa phrag pa nas bskor la/ oṃ sarbata thā ga ta kā ya bi shwa han ye swāhā/ zhes brjod la skudabyi/denas yang ba byung mar khu shing shun phyes mnyer gsum byas la/ mngar gsum gyi bum pa thogs te/ ji ltar bltams pa nas/ sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ zhes brjod cing bkru/ yang sngar ltar ras dkar gas dbyi/'og ma rnams la yang rdzas gsum gyis bkru bdang] denas bum chus bkru zhing] dbyi ba rnams zlozlo /lha sprin hā ༵ two ) ༈ ga / ji k+ta k+ṣiṃ pā dza/ r+sha dzī ༵ hūm̐ pa sta /sa(snye smaṃ rnyi pa/)pa/tsho la bkru/ sngar ltar dbyi/ rdzas gsum byugs/ 'bras bu sna tshogs kyi bum pa thogs te/ 'di ni 323
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum katshul khrims tshogasemal/ sngags kyi thog mtha' 'dra ba la/ da ti'i gnas su pha la 27gas brjod la bkru dpyi/ 'bru sna tshogs kyi bum pa 'ogs te/ 'di ni bzod pa'i mo bru ti sna na zlorgyu bkru dbyi rdzas gsum byugs/ 'bras yos kyi bum pa thogs te/ 'di ni brtson 'grus tshigasol/ oṃ sarba tshalari tshibakrudabye rdzas gsum byugs/ sman snatshogs pa'i bum pa thogasate/ 'di ni bsam tan tshigasol/oṃ sarba 5yo dzinyi shrīs hūṃ/ bkrudapyi/ rdzas gsum byugs/ rin 4 che'i bum pa thogs te/ 'di ni shes rab zlogasol/ oṃ tshim ṇi zlonyu bkru dbyi/ de dag sku la zlostu dbyi'o/ /oṃ hūṃ sāṃ sgyu āḥkā ya bi shwa ha nas swahā/ gzhan yang tshigs bcad ci rigs kyis bkru dbyi byas/ bkru ba'i tshe rol mo yang ma de nas mchog khrus la dbang bskur mkhan gyi lha spyan drangs dbang bskur par bsams nas mchog khus byad〈snas te/ dgranag gidakyil chog las/ de'i rjes lanam mkha' la bzhugs pa'i tsartsika la sogs pa'i rig pa'i tshogs rnams spyan drangs nas ye shes kyi bdud ji'i chus bkang ba'i bum pa bsnams pa de rnams kyisadabang bskur bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ ltaspyan drangs pa ni/ rang gi zugs spru'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ gshegs pa dang gshegs ma/ sems dpa' dang sems ma/ khro 'o dang khro mo'i tshogs badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/de bzhin gshegs spru nas/ bgegs bskrad par bsam la/rten la mngon du phyogs par las kyi bum pa btegs/ melha ga gi char 'phebs bzhin pas/ bkra shis gang zhig 〈snags bkra shis kyi glu blangs/ tshig rkang bzhi pa'i tshe rol mo bkrol zhing] me tog gi char 'bebs pa'i shis pa brjod pa ldon du btang lte lha'i bum pa blangs la/ ji ltar bltams pa nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a lha ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra sa tra hūṃ hūṃ swāhā/ zhes brjod cing bum chus bkru/ phyin drug ci rigs kyi tshigs bcad brjod la khus sga gang la nyes pa mi mnga' zhing/ zlokhus gsol/ /zhes brjod la khus ma de nas sku mtshog zloshog/ces brjod/ skudabyi ba ni/ de dag sku la 5swāhā/ sngar ltar ras 324
rab gnas kyi tsho gdage legs gnyer chen/kyis dbyi/ bder gshegs zlo〈snag/de nas stong gsum 5ba bu ṣa ṇi swāhā'i bar gyis dri byugs pa na bza' rgyan 'bul ba rnams dngos su s+phagnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ sdom ni/ mig dang sku zugags byin gyis brlabs/ /yi shes spyan drangs mchod nas ni/ /ga〈snal btab dam tshig pa la gzhug /dbang lha spyan drangs mchod nas ni/ /dbang bskur rigs bdag gis rgyas btab/ /mtshod bstod gos rgyan me long bstan/ /sgyin sreg 'bul zhing spyan dbye serdzogs/ /zhal bsil mchod yosnan sem rtsi'abul/ /dam bsgrag nas ni // lhas (spru dī dzong/ /zhepabriX / (lha lha/ dhī 〉spyad/ ṭ+wāṃ lhasnang :lha ṭ+wāṃ r+shamim/ pagri shā rdzu( sna papa bya'o/ /rgyas par byed na skye mched sku gsung thugs byin rlabs rang rang gi gzhung ltar byed/'jigs byed la/ rab tu gnas bya'i lha thams cad kyi mig gnyis su k+ṣ-i dang dngor lo las rdo rje mig dkar po dkar rdzo zhes pa nas/ thugs rdo rje'i lte ba'i nang du hūṃ dang rdo rje las thugs rdo rje nag 4 nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug par/ za ma tog ltar phyag mtshan dang bcas pa bskyed/ de nas ye shes pa spyan drangs pa ni/ lag tu slos thogs te rdor dril rol mo dang bcas/ ma lus sems can kun gyi ma〈snan gyur cing] nas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur par bsam la/ bcom ldan thugs rje'i blo dang ldan par mdzod/ ces brjod la spyan drangs nas bzhugs su gadrenal nas/ ma:snad pa ni/ 46 sarba ta thā ga ta am+bha nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ gadrenal ba gdab pa ni/ bdag nyid kyi lce hūṃ las skyes pa'i rdo rjer gyur bar bsam la/g.yas spos phor thogs te/ g.yon dril bu dkrol zhing / thugs rjes yis ni tshi mdzad par 'os/ lan gsum gartsol ba btab pas lha rnams kyis dgyes bzhin du gnang ba byin par gyur par bsam la/ dam tshig pa la gzhug pa ni/ lcags kyu'i phyag rgya byas la dzaḥ zhes brjod pas 325
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum kaye shes pa dam tsheg pa so so'i steng du bkug /'dod rgyal gyi phyag rgya byas la rgyuges brjod pas dam tshig pa serdzo dren la zhugs/ lcags sgrog gi phyag rgya byas la baṃ zhes brjod pas de dag la chu la chu bzhag bzhin du dbyer med du 'dres/ dril bu dkrol pa'i rnam pa byas/ hodzes brjod pas dgyes bzhin du bzhugs par bsam la/ de nas dbang lha spyan drangs pa ni/ rang gi thugs na'i khro 4 dang kho mo'i tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa ma dzamo spyan drangs mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa rngo dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis/ zhes pa nas dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma sgyi gtsug tu gnas pa las rab gnas kyi lha so rtso la mi bskyod pa dang rdo rje sems dpa' sogs kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ thams cad rdo rje 'jigs byed du bskyed pa yin na/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par bsam dgos kyis/rdo rje sems dpa' zhes pa dor/ de nas rab gnas skya lha la mtshod pa ni/ rang rang gi dkyil gangor dang 'bral bar byin gyis rlabs la chu bzhi nyer rgyud rol mo rnams phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ dag cing dri med serdzogs dang / lha yi me tog sesnags kyis 'bul/ bla med kyi skabs su nang mchod kyang 'bul/ bstod pa ni/ gsang 'dus ltar na mi bskyod rdo rje sogs dang / lajigs byed ltar na 'jam dpal gser mdog ma lta bus bstod/ gos zung btegs la/ srab 'jam hā swā sa 〈snas phul/ rin po che'i rgyan drug la 〈snags btegs la/ rgyal ba mtshan dab se gas kyis rgyan phul/ me long bstan la/ a las skyes pa'i me long] zlos ta.aḥde nas grub na rab gnas kyi lha rtso so nas me tog gis thab tu spyan drangs la/ sgyin sreg 'bul bar bya dgos te/ sdom 'byung las/ de ltar las ni kun bya'i pyir/ /sbyin sreg las kyis rdzogs par byas/ /lha kun zhal ni me yin pas/ /mkhas pas rab tu gnas par bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ 'dir rten so so lha so sor bskyed na rten de dang de'i mdun nas lha de dang de'i sngags brjod la me tog len 326
